ex: Can you wait *a few minutes*? The bus is coming.
你可以等幾分鐘嗎？公車快來了。
*Quite a few* students in my class have a cat.
我們班上有相當多同學養貓。
I only have *a little time* before my next class.
下堂課前我只剩一點時間。
Can you speak *a little bit* slower, please?
可以請你說慢一點點嗎？
There are *a lot of* people on the MRT this morning.
今天早上捷運上有很多人。
*Thanks a lot* for helping me with my homework.
非常感謝你幫我寫作業。
I feel *a lot better* after a good night's sleep.
好好睡一覺後，我覺得好很多了。
I get up *at seven a.m.* on school days.
上學日我早上七點起床。

collocs.zh: 從上午九點到下午五點
ex: The library is open *from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.*
圖書館從上午九點開放到下午五點。
I go to swimming class *once a week*.
我一週上一次游泳課。
I spend *half an hour* on the MRT every morning.
我每天早上搭捷運要花半小時。
Heavy rain made us *abandon our plan* to go hiking.
大雨讓我們放棄了去爬山的計畫。
Students were told to stay away from the *abandoned building*.
學生被告知要遠離那棟廢棄的建築。
The rescue team never *abandoned hope* of finding the missing hikers.
搜救隊從未放棄找到失蹤山友的希望。
The Mass Rapid Transit system is often *abbreviated to* MRT.
大眾捷運系統常被縮寫成 MRT。
"Info" is an *abbreviated form* of the word "information."
「info」是「information」這個字的縮寫形式。
Players who don't *abide by the rules* will be asked to leave.
不遵守規則的選手會被要求離場。
My mother *can't abide* people who talk loudly on the MRT.
我媽媽受不了在捷運上大聲講話的人。
Everyone *has the ability to* learn a new language.
每個人都有能力學習一種新語言。
She has a *natural ability* to make people laugh.
她天生就有逗人發笑的本事。
I *was able to* finish the test on time.
我能夠準時寫完考試。
Teachers should report any *abnormal behavior* they notice in students.
老師應該通報他們在學生身上注意到的任何異常行為。
Farmers are worried about the *abnormal weather* this spring.
農民擔心今年春天的異常天氣。
On my first day at work, the manager smiled and said *welcome aboard*.
我上班第一天，經理微笑著說歡迎加入。
We had to wait an hour before we could *go aboard* the ship.
我們得等一個小時才能上船。
The United States *abolished slavery* in the 1860s.
美國在 1860 年代廢除了奴隸制度。
Some people think Taiwan should *abolish the death penalty*.
有些人認為台灣應該廢除死刑。
*Aboriginal people* have lived on the island for thousands of years.
原住民已經在這座島上生活了數千年。
The museum helps visitors learn about *aboriginal culture* and music.
這間博物館幫助遊客認識原住民的文化與音樂。
In some countries it is illegal to *have an abortion*.
在某些國家，墮胎是違法的。
The old town *abounds with* small shops and street food.
這座老城鎮到處都是小店和街頭小吃。
*Rumors abound* that the school will change its uniform next year.
謠傳學校明年要換制服。
My friends and I *talked about* the new teacher at lunch.
我和朋友午餐時聊到新來的老師。
Don't *worry about* the test. You studied hard.
別擔心考試，你已經很用功了。
It takes *about ten minutes* to walk to school.
走路到學校大約要十分鐘。
Yushan is almost 4,000 meters *above sea level*.
玉山海拔將近四千公尺。
Her English score is *above average* this term.
她這學期的英文成績高於平均。
Look at *the example above* before you start.
開始之前先看上面的例子。
My cousin wants to *study abroad* after high school.
我表哥高中畢業後想出國留學。
We usually *travel abroad* during summer vacation.
我們通常在暑假出國旅行。
Have you ever *gone abroad* by yourself?
你曾經自己一個人出國過嗎？
There was an *abrupt change* in the weather after lunch.
午餐後天氣突然變了。
The concert *came to an abrupt end* when the power went out.
停電時演唱會突然結束了。
His long *absence from school* worried the teacher.
他長時間缺課，讓老師很擔心。
She came back to the club after *a long absence*.
她離開很久之後，又回到社團了。
Three students *were absent from* class today.
今天有三個同學缺席。
The classroom fell into *absolute silence* when the principal walked in.
校長一走進來，教室就陷入一片寂靜。
I'm an *absolute beginner*, so please explain the rules slowly.
我完全是新手，所以請慢慢解釋規則。
This towel can *absorb water* much faster than a cotton one.
這條毛巾吸水的速度比棉質毛巾快得多。
He *was so absorbed in* his novel that he missed his MRT stop.
他太沉迷於小說，結果坐過了捷運站。
It's hard to *absorb so much information* the night before an exam.
考試前一晚很難吸收這麼多資訊。
We saw a lot of *abstract art* at the museum in Taipei.
我們在台北的美術館看到很多抽象藝術作品。
Our teacher used drawings to explain the *abstract concept* of time.
老師用圖畫來解釋時間這個抽象概念。
Math problems in senior high require a higher *level of abstraction*.
高中的數學題需要更高的抽象程度。
At first, everyone laughed at his *absurd idea*.
一開始大家都嘲笑他荒謬的想法。
*It is absurd to* pay that much for a phone case.
花那麼多錢買手機殼是很荒謬的。
The forest is home to *an abundance of* wildlife.
這片森林是大量野生動物的家園。
Rain falls *in abundance* here during the plum rain season.
梅雨季時這裡的雨量非常充沛。
The country is poor despite its *abundant resources*.
這個國家雖然資源豐富卻很貧窮。
There is *abundant evidence* that exercise improves memory.
有充分的證據顯示運動能改善記憶力。
Teachers are trained to notice signs of *child abuse*.
老師受過訓練，能注意到虐童的跡象。
The talk at school was about the dangers of *drug abuse*.
學校的演講是關於藥物濫用的危害。
The official was accused of *abusing his power*.
那名官員被指控濫用職權。
Getting enough sleep can improve your *academic performance*.
充足的睡眠能提升你的學業表現。
The new *academic year* in Taiwan starts in September.
台灣的新學年從九月開始。
After graduation, he plans to attend a *military academy*.
畢業後，他打算去讀軍校。
She works as a researcher at the national *academy of sciences*.
她在國家科學院擔任研究員。
The government wants to *accelerate growth* in green energy.
政府想要加速綠能的成長。
New software can *accelerate the process* of checking homework.
新軟體可以加快批改作業的過程。
Her uncle speaks English with a *strong accent*.
她舅舅說英文帶有濃厚的口音。
The tour guide in London spoke with a lovely *British accent*.
倫敦的導遊說話帶著好聽的英國口音。
I *accepted the invitation* to her birthday party.
我接受了她生日派對的邀請。
Please *accept my apology* for being late.
我遲到了，請接受我的道歉。
The new school rules were *acceptable to* most students and parents.
新的校規大多數學生和家長都能接受。
Smoking indoors is no longer *socially acceptable* in Taiwan.
在台灣，室內抽菸已經不再被社會接受。
The air pollution today is above *an acceptable level*.
今天的空氣污染超過了可接受的程度。
She cried with joy when her *acceptance letter* arrived.
她收到錄取通知時高興得哭了。
The new idea slowly *gained acceptance* among the teachers.
這個新想法慢慢獲得老師們的認同。
Not every student *has access to* a computer at home.
不是每個學生在家都能使用電腦。
The hotel offers free *internet access* in every room.
這家飯店每個房間都提供免費網路。
You can *access the information* on the school website.
你可以在學校網站上取得這些資訊。
The library's online books are *accessible to* all students.
圖書館的線上書籍所有學生都能使用。

collocs.zh: 容易到達的；容易取得的
ex: The hotel is *easily accessible* by bus or MRT.
這家飯店搭公車或捷運都很容易到達。
For many teens, a phone has become a *fashion accessory*.
對許多青少年來說，手機已經成了時尚配件。
The store sells keyboards, mice, and other *computer accessories*.
這家店販售鍵盤、滑鼠和其他電腦周邊配件。
I deleted the photo *by accident*.
我不小心把照片刪掉了。
My uncle *had an accident* on his scooter last week.
我叔叔上週騎機車出了意外。
Nobody was hurt in the *traffic accident*.
那場車禍沒有人受傷。
Penicillin was an *accidental discovery* in a London lab.
盤尼西林是在倫敦一間實驗室裡意外發現的。
The insurance covers *accidental damage* to your phone.
這份保險涵蓋手機的意外損壞。
The novel received *critical acclaim* soon after it came out.
這本小說一出版就獲得評論界的好評。
The *widely acclaimed* musical is coming to Kaohsiung next month.
那齣廣受好評的音樂劇下個月要來高雄。
The new library tries to *accommodate the needs of* every reader.
新圖書館努力配合每位讀者的需求。
The new MRT trains can *accommodate up to* two thousand passengers.
新的捷運列車最多可容納兩千名乘客。
It can be hard to *find accommodation* near the university.
在大學附近找住處可能很困難。
The college offers cheap *student accommodation* on campus.
這所大學在校內提供便宜的學生宿舍。
Children under twelve must *be accompanied by* an adult.
十二歲以下的兒童必須由成人陪同。
Our music teacher *accompanied the choir on the piano*.
我們的音樂老師用鋼琴為合唱團伴奏。
With hard work, you can *accomplish your goals*.
只要努力，你就能達成目標。
Finishing the marathon gave me *a sense of accomplishment*.
跑完馬拉松讓我很有成就感。
He cleaned the classroom *of his own accord*.
他主動打掃了教室。
Her actions are not *in accord with* her words.
她的行為和她說的話並不一致。
Students must dress *in accordance with* the school dress code.
學生必須依照學校的服裝規定穿著。
Read the safety rules carefully and *act accordingly*.
仔細閱讀安全規定，並照著去做。
If the test date changes, we will *adjust accordingly*.
如果考試日期改變，我們會做相應的調整。
My parents opened a *bank account* for me.
我爸媽幫我開了一個銀行帳戶。
Students *account for* half of the library's visitors.
學生占了圖書館訪客的一半。
The company will *be held accountable for* the pollution in the river.
這家公司將被追究河川污染的責任。
The class leader is *accountable to* the teacher and the students.
班長要對老師和同學負責。
Many small shops *hire an accountant* to do their taxes.
很多小店會請會計師幫忙報稅。
She studied hard to become a *certified public accountant*.
她努力讀書，想成為一名會計師。
After graduation, she joined a large *accounting firm*.
畢業後，她進入一家大型會計師事務所。
Please send the receipts to the *accounting department*.
請把收據送到會計部門。
He *accumulated wealth* slowly by saving part of every paycheck.
他靠著每次薪水存一部分，慢慢累積財富。
A part-time job helps students *accumulate experience* before college.
打工能幫助學生在上大學前累積經驗。
Reading every day leads to a steady *accumulation of knowledge*.
每天閱讀會讓知識穩定地累積。
Too much sugar can cause *fat accumulation* around the waist.
攝取太多糖會造成腰部脂肪堆積。
The robot can measure the distance *with great accuracy*.
這個機器人能非常精確地測量距離。
Daily practice will help you *improve the accuracy* of your typing.
每天練習能幫你提高打字的準確度。
Reporters must check their facts to give *accurate information*.
記者必須查證事實，才能提供準確的資訊。
This new test is *highly accurate* in finding the virus.
這種新的檢測在找出病毒方面非常準確。
You shouldn't *make an accusation* without any proof.
你不應該在沒有任何證據的情況下提出指控。
The singer quickly *denied the accusation* on social media.
那位歌手很快就在社群媒體上否認了指控。
A *false accusation* can seriously hurt someone's reputation.
不實的指控可能嚴重傷害一個人的名聲。
The store *accused him of* stealing a phone case.
那家店指控他偷了一個手機殼。
He *was falsely accused* of cheating on the exam.
他被誣指考試作弊。
I'm not *accustomed to* getting up so early on weekends.
我不習慣在週末那麼早起床。
My eyes slowly *became accustomed to* the dark room.
我的眼睛慢慢習慣了那個黑暗的房間。
My grandfather often talks about his *aches and pains*.
我爺爺常常說起他身上的各種病痛。
I've had *a dull ache* in my tooth since yesterday.
我的牙從昨天開始就隱隱作痛。
It took him two years to *achieve his goal* of running a marathon.
他花了兩年才達成跑完一場馬拉松的目標。
Finishing the hard puzzle gave me *a sense of achievement*.
完成那個很難的拼圖讓我很有成就感。
The school gives prizes for *academic achievement* every semester.
學校每學期都會頒獎給學業表現優異的學生。
*Acid rain* can damage trees and old buildings.
酸雨會損害樹木和古老的建築。
Proteins are made up of many *amino acids*.
蛋白質是由許多胺基酸組成的。
We must *acknowledge the fact that* the plan has failed.
我們必須承認這個計畫已經失敗的事實。
She is *widely acknowledged* as the best player on the team.
她被公認為隊上最好的球員。

collocs.zh: 為了表示對……的感謝或認可
ex: He received a prize *in acknowledgement of* his hard work.
他獲頒獎項，以表揚他的努力。
My brother *suffered from acne* all through junior high.
我哥哥整個國中都受青春痘困擾。
The doctor said her *acne scars* would fade over time.
醫生說她的痘疤會隨著時間變淡。
Please *acquaint yourself with* the safety rules before the lab.
做實驗前請先熟悉安全規則。
Are you *acquainted with* the new math teacher?
你認識新來的數學老師嗎？
We're only *casual acquaintances*, so I don't know her well.
我們只是泛泛之交，所以我跟她不太熟。
*An acquaintance of mine* runs a small café in Tainan.
我認識的一個人在台南開了一家小咖啡廳。
Reading widely is a great way to *acquire knowledge*.
廣泛閱讀是獲得知識的好方法。
It takes time to *acquire a new skill* like cooking.
學會像烹飪這樣的新技能需要時間。
Stinky tofu is an *acquired taste* for many visitors.
對許多遊客來說，臭豆腐是要慢慢才會喜歡的味道。
Young children are very good at *language acquisition*.
幼童非常擅長習得語言。
School is not only about the *acquisition of knowledge*.
上學不只是為了獲得知識。
The family owns several *acres of land* near the coast.
那家人在海岸附近擁有好幾英畝的土地。
The bakery is *across the street* from our school.
麵包店就在我們學校的對街。
The MRT station is *across from* the park.
捷運站在公園對面。
Be careful when you *walk across* the road.
過馬路時要小心。
We must *act quickly* when there is a fire.
發生火災時，我們必須迅速行動。
My sister will *act in a play* at school.
我妹妹會在學校演一齣戲。
Giving up your seat is *an act of kindness*.
讓座是一種善行。
We need to *take action* to keep our school clean.
我們必須採取行動，保持校園整潔。
My brother loves watching *action movies* on weekends.
我哥哥週末很愛看動作片。
My grandma walks every day to *stay active*.
我奶奶每天走路，讓身體保持活動力。
She *takes an active part in* the school's English club.
她積極參與學校的英文社。
The *environmental activist* spoke to our class about plastic waste.
那位環保人士來我們班上談塑膠垃圾。
The *human rights activist* was arrested for speaking out.
那位人權運動人士因發聲而被捕。
Hiking is one of my favorite *outdoor activities*.
爬山是我最喜歡的戶外活動之一。
We have *club activities* every Friday afternoon.
我們每週五下午有社團活動。
Kids need an hour of *physical activity* every day.
孩子每天需要一小時的體能活動。
He dreams of becoming *a famous actor*.
他夢想成為一位有名的演員。
Who won *Best Actor* at the awards this year?
今年頒獎典禮上誰得到最佳男主角？
My cousin wants to be *a famous actor* someday.
我表弟希望有一天成為有名的演員。
She won *Best Actress* for her first movie.
她以第一部電影拿下最佳女主角。
*A famous actress* visited our school today.
今天有一位有名的女演員來我們學校。
The young star won *Best Actress* last night.
那位年輕的明星昨晚拿下最佳女主角。
*The actual price* was higher than the ad said.
實際價格比廣告上寫的還高。
This picture shows the bug at *actual size*.
這張圖畫的是蟲子的實際大小。
Nobody knows *what actually happened* that night.
沒有人知道那天晚上實際上發生了什麼事。
He felt *acute pain* in his knee after the game.
比賽後他覺得膝蓋劇痛。
The island faces an *acute shortage* of fresh water.
這座島面臨淡水嚴重短缺。
Dogs have an *acute sense of smell*.
狗有敏銳的嗅覺。
It took me a month to *adapt to* my new school.
我花了一個月才適應新學校。
The movie *was adapted from* a popular novel.
這部電影改編自一本暢銷小說。
The *film adaptation* of the novel was a huge hit.
那本小說改編的電影非常賣座。
The study looks at plants' *adaptation to* dry weather.
這項研究探討植物對乾燥氣候的適應。
*Add salt* to the soup at the end.
最後再在湯裡加鹽。
*Add up* all the numbers and write the answer.
把所有數字加起來，寫下答案。
The heavy rain *added to* the traffic problems downtown.
大雨讓市區的交通問題更嚴重。
Many teenagers *are addicted to* their phones and sleep too little.
很多青少年對手機上癮，睡得太少。
My dad is a *coffee addict* who drinks four cups a day.
我爸爸是個咖啡成癮的人，一天喝四杯。
His *addiction to* his phone made it hard to focus in class.
他對手機上癮，讓他上課很難專心。
The program helps young people recover from *drug addiction*.
這個計畫幫助年輕人戒除毒癮。
The school counselor gave a talk on *internet addiction*.
學校輔導老師做了一場關於網路成癮的演講。
*In addition*, you need to bring a pencil.
此外，你還需要帶一枝鉛筆。
*In addition to* English, she studies Japanese.
除了英文，她還學日文。
Little kids learn *addition and subtraction* first.
小朋友先學加法和減法。
Delivery to your home comes at an *additional cost*.
送貨到府需要額外付費。
For *additional information*, please visit the school website.
如需更多資訊，請上學校網站查詢。
Please write your *home address* on the form.
請在表格上寫下你的住家地址。
What's your *email address*? I'll send you the notes.
你的電子郵件地址是什麼？我把筆記寄給你。
Teenagers need *adequate sleep* to stay healthy and do well at school.
青少年需要充足的睡眠才能保持健康、在學校表現良好。
This old laptop is *adequate for* writing reports.
這台舊筆電用來寫報告還夠用。
It took a while to *adjust to* life in a dorm.
適應宿舍生活花了一段時間。
The coach *made some adjustments* to our training plan.
教練對我們的訓練計畫做了一些調整。
The teacher will *administer the test* in the school library.
老師會在學校圖書館舉行這場考試。
Only the school nurse is allowed to *administer medicine* to students.
只有學校護理師可以給學生用藥。
He wants to study *business administration* in college.
他想在大學讀企業管理。
*The current administration* promised to lower housing prices.
現任政府承諾要降低房價。
The *administrative staff* will help you with the forms.
行政人員會協助你填寫表格。
The charity tries to keep its *administrative costs* low.
這個慈善機構努力壓低行政成本。

春天的到來帶來比較溫暖的天氣。
We *arrived at* school just before eight.
我們在八點前剛好到學校。
We *arrived in* Tokyo late at night.
我們深夜抵達東京。
The MRT almost always *arrives on time*.
捷運幾乎總是準時到站。
His *arrogant attitude* made him unpopular in class.
他傲慢的態度讓他在班上不受歡迎。
He learned to shoot a *bow and arrow* at camp.
他在營隊學會射箭。
*Follow the arrows* to find the exit.
跟著箭頭走就能找到出口。
We drew our friends in *art class* today.
我們今天在美術課畫朋友。
This painting is a real *work of art*.
這幅畫是真正的藝術品。
Our class visited the *art museum* last week.
我們班上週參觀了美術館。
I *read an article* about healthy food.
我讀了一篇關於健康食物的文章。
She *wrote an article* for the school newspaper.
她為校刊寫了一篇文章。
Our teacher showed us a *newspaper article* about the typhoon.
老師給我們看一篇關於颱風的報紙文章。
Debate class helps students *articulate their ideas*.
辯論課幫助學生清楚表達想法。
The new class leader is *highly articulate* and confident.
新的班長非常善於表達又有自信。
*Artificial intelligence* is changing the way we study.
人工智慧正在改變我們讀書的方式。
The restaurant was decorated with *artificial flowers* for the holiday.
這家餐廳為了過節用人造花裝飾。
*A famous artist* painted this picture.
這幅畫是一位有名的藝術家畫的。
*Street artists* perform near the MRT station on weekends.
週末捷運站附近有街頭藝人表演。
She showed great *artistic talent* at a young age.
她從小就展現出很高的藝術天分。
My mom *works as* a nurse at a big hospital.
我媽媽在一家大醫院當護理師。
My brother is *as tall as* my dad.
我哥哥和爸爸一樣高。
I like fruit, *such as* mangoes and bananas.
我喜歡水果，例如芒果和香蕉。
The students *ascended the stairs* to the top floor of the library.
學生們走上樓梯到圖書館頂樓。
Please list the numbers *in ascending order*.
請把這些數字由小到大排列。
Flights were canceled because of *volcanic ash* in the sky.
因為空中有火山灰，航班都取消了。
The old wooden house *burned to ashes* in less than an hour.
那棟老木屋不到一個小時就燒成灰燼。
You did your best, so you have nothing to *be ashamed of*.
你已經盡力了，沒有什麼好羞愧的。
He *was ashamed to* tell anyone about his bad grades.
他不好意思跟任何人說他成績很差。
*Aside from* the rain, we had a great trip.
除了下雨之外，我們的旅行很棒。
I *set aside* an hour every day to practice English.
我每天撥出一個小時練習英文。
She *puts aside* part of her salary every month.
她每個月都存下一部分薪水。
Can I *ask a question* about the homework?
我可以問一個關於作業的問題嗎？
Don't be afraid to *ask for* help.
別害怕開口請人幫忙。
My mom *asked me to* clean my room.
我媽媽要我打掃房間。
I *fell asleep* in front of the TV.
我在電視機前睡著了。
The baby is *fast asleep* in her bed.
寶寶在她的床上睡得很熟。
Smartphones have changed *every aspect of* our lives.
智慧型手機改變了我們生活的各個方面。
Sleep is an *important aspect* of good health.
睡眠是身體健康很重要的一環。
She *aspires to* a career in medicine.
她立志從事醫療工作。
The contest is open to every *aspiring writer* under twenty.
這項比賽開放給所有二十歲以下有志寫作的人參加。
The ancient emperor *was assassinated* by his own guards.
那位古代皇帝遭到自己的侍衛暗殺。
The police are investigating a *physical assault* near the station.
警方正在調查車站附近的一起傷害案。
The army *launched an assault* on the city at dawn.
軍隊在黎明時對城市發動攻擊。
It took my dad three hours to *assemble the furniture*.
我爸爸花了三個小時組裝家具。
She works on an *assembly line* in a car factory.
她在汽車工廠的生產線上工作。
*Freedom of assembly* is protected by law in Taiwan.
在台灣，集會自由受到法律保障。

collocs.zh: 堅持自己的主張；表現自信
ex: Shy students need practice to *assert themselves* in group work.
害羞的學生需要練習在小組活動中表達主見。
Workers joined together to *assert their rights*.
勞工團結起來維護自己的權利。
Officials came to *assess the damage* after the earthquake.
地震後官員前來評估損失。
The school did a *risk assessment* before the hiking trip.
學校在登山活動前做了風險評估。
It's too early to *make an assessment* of the new rules.
現在評估新規定還太早。
A good attitude is a *valuable asset* at any job.
良好的態度在任何工作中都是寶貴的資產。
She is *an asset to* our basketball team.
她是我們籃球隊的寶貴人才。
The manager *assigned a task* to each new worker.
經理分派了一項任務給每位新員工。
Remember to *hand in your assignment* by Friday.
記得在星期五前交作業。
Tonight's *homework assignment* is to read chapter three.
今晚的回家作業是讀第三章。
Students can *assist with* cleaning the park on weekends.
學生可以在週末協助打掃公園。
Two nurses *assisted in* the operation on my father's knee.
兩位護理師協助我爸爸的膝蓋手術。
Some students get *financial assistance* from the government.
有些學生獲得政府的經濟補助。
Volunteers *provided assistance* to people after the earthquake.
地震後，志工為民眾提供協助。
Please let me know if I can *be of assistance*.
如果我能幫上忙，請告訴我。
The *teaching assistant* checks our homework.
助教會檢查我們的作業。
The *sales assistant* helped me find the right size.
店員幫我找到合適的尺寸。
Many people *associate summer with* the beach and cold drinks.
很多人會把夏天和海灘、冷飲聯想在一起。
Smoking *is associated with* many serious health problems, including cancer.
抽菸和許多嚴重的健康問題有關，包括癌症。
The concert was held *in association with* a local charity.
這場音樂會是與當地一個慈善團體合辦的。
Scientists found an *association between* sleep and memory.
科學家發現睡眠和記憶之間有關聯。
I *assumed that* the class was canceled.
我以為那堂課取消了。
*Let's assume* the bus is late again.
我們假設公車又誤點了。
We *made an assumption* that the test would be easy.
我們以為考試會很簡單。
We planned the trip *on the assumption that* it wouldn't rain.
我們以不會下雨為前提安排了這趟旅行。
She works in *quality assurance* at a tech company.
她在一家科技公司負責品質保證。
She answered the judges' questions calmly and *with assurance*.
她冷靜而自信地回答評審的問題。
I *assure you that* your bag is safe with us.
我向你保證你的包包放在我們這裡很安全。
*Rest assured* that we will finish the project on time.
請放心，我們會準時完成這項專案。
Cold air can sometimes trigger an *asthma attack*.
冷空氣有時會引發氣喘發作。
Many children in big cities *suffer from asthma*.
大城市裡很多孩子患有氣喘。
We *were astonished at* how fast he solved the problem.
我們對他解題的速度感到很驚訝。
She stared at her test score *in astonishment*.
她驚訝地盯著自己的考試分數。

令我驚訝的是，那個害羞的男孩贏了演講比賽。
My package *went astray* somewhere between Taipei and Tainan.
我的包裹在台北和台南之間的某處寄丟了。
His parents worried that bad friends would *lead him astray*.
他的父母擔心壞朋友會把他帶壞。
It takes years of training to *become an astronaut*.
要成為太空人需要多年的訓練。
An *amateur astronomer* was the first to spot the new comet.
一位業餘天文學家最先發現了那顆新彗星。
The *astronomy club* is planning a trip to watch the meteor shower.
天文社正在計畫去看流星雨。
I usually do my homework *at night*.
我通常晚上寫作業。
We stayed *at home* because of the typhoon.
因為颱風，我們待在家裡。
He dreams of becoming a *professional athlete* in baseball.
他夢想成為職業棒球選手。
*Student athletes* have to balance training and schoolwork.
學生運動員必須兼顧訓練和課業。
His *athletic ability* helped him win a sports scholarship.
他的運動能力讓他獲得了體育獎學金。
Basketball and football are the biggest sports in American *college athletics*.
籃球和美式足球是美國大學體育競賽中最熱門的運動。
I like this café because of its *relaxed atmosphere*.
我喜歡這家咖啡廳，因為它的氣氛很輕鬆。
Some gases trap heat in *the earth's atmosphere*.
有些氣體會把熱困在地球的大氣層中。
Scientists first *split the atom* in the 1930s.
科學家在1930年代首次分裂了原子。
The *atomic bomb* changed the history of the world.
原子彈改變了世界的歷史。
*Atomic energy* can produce a lot of electricity.
原子能可以產生大量的電力。
My little sister is very *attached to* her old teddy bear.
我妹妹非常依戀她的舊泰迪熊。
Never open an *email attachment* from a stranger.
絕對不要打開陌生人寄來的郵件附件。
The hiker *was attacked by* a wild dog.
那位登山客被野狗攻擊了。
My neighbor had a *heart attack* last year.
我鄰居去年心臟病發作。
The town was *under attack* during the war.
那個城鎮在戰爭中遭受攻擊。
It took him three years to *attain his goal* of running a marathon.
他花了三年才達成跑完馬拉松的目標。
The survey asked about each person's *educational attainment*.
這份調查詢問了每個人的教育程度。
She passed her driving test on her *first attempt*.
她第一次考駕照就通過了。
He *attempted to* break the school record.
他試圖打破學校紀錄。
All parents are invited to *attend the meeting*.
所有家長都受邀出席會議。
You must *attend class* every day.
你必須每天來上課。
My sister *attends school* in Taipei.
我姊姊在台北上學。
The teacher *takes attendance* at the start of every class.
老師每堂課一開始都會點名。
The club's *attendance rate* dropped during exam week.
社團的出席率在考試週下降了。

空服員拿了一條毯子和一些水給我。
The *gas station attendant* checked the air in our tires.
加油站的員工幫我們檢查了輪胎的氣壓。
Please *pay attention to* the teacher.
請專心聽老師講課。
The loud music *got everyone's attention*.
大聲的音樂引起了大家的注意。
My grandparents keep old photos *in the attic*.
我祖父母把舊照片放在閣樓裡。
His *attitude toward* learning changed after he joined the club.
他加入社團後，對學習的態度改變了。
A *positive attitude* can help you get through hard times.
積極的態度能幫你度過難關。
The *defense attorney* asked the witness several questions.
辯護律師問了證人幾個問題。
The *district attorney* decided not to charge him.
地方檢察官決定不起訴他。
The bright red car *attracted attention* from everyone on the street.
那輛亮紅色的車吸引了街上所有人的注意。
The town built a new park to *attract tourists*.
這個小鎮蓋了一座新公園來吸引觀光客。
Many young people *are attracted to* jobs in tech.
許多年輕人被科技業的工作吸引。
The old street has become a famous *tourist attraction*.
那條老街已經成為著名的觀光景點。
I've always felt a strong *attraction to* the ocean.
我一直深深受到大海的吸引。
The company made him an *attractive offer* with a high salary.
那家公司開出高薪這樣誘人的條件給他。
Cheap flights make Japan *attractive to* Taiwanese travelers.
便宜的機票讓日本對台灣旅客很有吸引力。
Doctors *attribute his illness to* stress.
醫生把他的病歸因於壓力。
The fire *was attributed to* a faulty heater.
這場火災被認為是電暖器故障引起的。
The singer's guitar was sold *at auction* last week.
那位歌手的吉他上週在拍賣會上售出。
The school *auctioned off* students' art to raise money.
學校拍賣學生的藝術作品來募款。
The concert drew *a large audience* despite the rain.
儘管下雨，那場音樂會仍吸引了大批觀眾。
The *target audience* of this show is teenagers.
這個節目的目標觀眾是青少年。
You can download the *audio files* from the textbook website.
你可以從課本網站下載音訊檔。
The museum offers an *audio guide* in five languages.
這間博物館提供五種語言的語音導覽。
The city will *carry out an audit* of the school's spending.
市政府將對學校的支出進行稽核。
My uncle kept all his receipts in case of a *tax audit*.
我舅舅保留了所有收據以防稅務稽查。
The *school auditorium* was full for the English drama contest.
英語話劇比賽時學校禮堂座無虛席。
Our summer vacation ends *in August*.
我們的暑假在八月結束。

collocs.zh: 阿姨和姨丈；姑姑和姑丈
ex: We visited my *aunt and uncle* during Chinese New Year.
過年時我們去拜訪阿姨和姨丈。
We tried *authentic food* at a small stand in Tainan.
我們在台南一個小攤子吃到道地的美食。
*A famous author* came to talk at our school.
一位知名作家來我們學校演講。
Who is your *favorite author*, and why?
你最喜歡的作家是誰？為什麼？
*The authorities* closed the road because of the landslide.
當局因為山崩而封閉了那條路。
Our biology teacher is *an authority on* Taiwanese birds.
我們的生物老師是台灣鳥類的權威。
People *in authority* should listen to the public.
掌權的人應該傾聽大眾的聲音。
My parents *authorized my aunt to* sign the form for me.
我爸媽授權阿姨幫我簽表格。
Buy your phone from an *authorized dealer*.
請向授權經銷商購買手機。
Many athletes *write an autobiography* after they retire from sports.
許多運動員退休後會寫自傳。
A young fan *asked for an autograph* after the game.
比賽結束後，一位年輕的球迷要求簽名。
The players stayed after the game to *sign autographs* for fans.
球員們賽後留下來為球迷簽名。
The *automatic doors* opened as we walked into the store.
我們走進商店時，自動門就打開了。
The new parking lot is *fully automatic*, with no staff at all.
新的停車場是全自動的，完全沒有工作人員。
Many jobs in this city depend on the *automobile industry*.
這座城市有許多工作仰賴汽車工業。
My uncle runs a small factory that makes *auto parts*.
我叔叔經營一間生產汽車零件的小工廠。
The law protects *personal autonomy* in medical decisions.
法律保障醫療決定上的個人自主權。
Each club has *a degree of autonomy* in planning events.
每個社團在規劃活動上都有一定的自主權。
The leaves turn red *in the fall*.
秋天時樹葉會變紅。
We took photos of the *autumn leaves* in Japan.
我們在日本拍了秋天的楓葉。
The class notes are *available online*.
上課筆記可以在網路上找到。
Is the teacher *available for* a quick question?
老師有空回答一個小問題嗎？
The school *explored every avenue* to find money for the new gym.
學校嘗試各種途徑籌錢蓋新體育館。
I'm just an *average student*, but I work hard.
我只是個普通的學生，但我很努力。
*On average*, I sleep seven hours a night.
我平均每晚睡七個小時。
His math score was *below average*.
他的數學成績低於平均。
The two sides held talks to *avert a crisis*.
雙方舉行會談以避免危機。
She *averted her eyes* during the scary part of the movie.
電影演到恐怖的地方時，她把視線移開。
The *aviation industry* was hit hard when travel stopped.
旅遊停擺時，航空業受到重創。
She works for the *civil aviation* office at the airport.
她在機場的民航單位工作。
Check your work to *avoid mistakes*.
檢查你的作業以避免犯錯。
We left early to *avoid traffic*.
我們提早出發以避開車潮。
Students *eagerly await* the start of summer vacation.
學生們熱切期待暑假的到來。
We are still *awaiting the results* of the speech contest.
我們還在等演講比賽的結果。
After drinking coffee, I was *wide awake* all night.
喝了咖啡之後，我整晚都很清醒。
It was hard to *stay awake* during the long lecture.
在那場冗長的演講中很難保持清醒。
I *lay awake* for hours thinking about the exam results.
我躺著好幾個小時睡不著，一直想著考試成績。
The science show *awakened my interest* in space.
那個科學節目喚起了我對太空的興趣。
We *were awakened by* the birds outside the window.
我們被窗外的鳥叫聲吵醒。
Our short film *won an award* at the student film festival.
我們的短片在學生影展中得獎。
Parents were invited to the *award ceremony* at the end of the year.
家長受邀參加年底的頒獎典禮。
He *was awarded* a scholarship to study in the US.
他獲得一筆到美國讀書的獎學金。
Most people are *aware of* the dangers of drunk driving.
大多數人都知道酒駕的危險。
Over time, I *became aware* that my friend was unhappy.
漸漸地，我開始意識到我的朋友不開心。
Young people today are more *environmentally aware* than before.
現在的年輕人比以前更有環保意識。
*Go away*! I'm doing my homework now.
走開！我在寫作業。
My best friend lives *far away* now.
我最好的朋友現在住得很遠。
Please call your mom back *right away*.
請馬上回電給你媽媽。
The young players are *in awe of* their famous coach.
年輕球員很敬畏他們那位知名教練。
Visitors *stand in awe* before the huge waterfall.
遊客在巨大的瀑布前驚嘆不已。
Your new haircut *looks awesome*!
你的新髮型看起來超讚！
Studying in Japan for a month was *an awesome experience*.
在日本念書一個月是很棒的經驗。
I *felt awful* about forgetting my best friend's birthday.
我忘了好朋友的生日，覺得很過意不去。
We have *an awful lot of* homework this week.
我們這週的作業非常多。
Why don't you *stay awhile* and have some tea?
你何不待一會兒，喝點茶？
We had to *wait awhile* for the next MRT train.
我們得等一下下一班捷運。
There was an *awkward silence* after he forgot her name.
他忘了她的名字之後，現場一陣尷尬的沉默。
Being late for your own birthday party is an *awkward situation*.
自己的生日派對遲到是很尷尬的處境。
My aunt is going to *have a baby* in May.
我阿姨五月要生小寶寶了。
My *baby brother* cries every night.
我的小弟弟每晚都會哭。
My parents *hired a baby sitter* for the weekend.
我爸媽週末請了一位保母。
My cousin *works as a baby sitter* after school.
我表姊放學後當臨時保母。
She earned a *bachelor's degree* in chemistry last year.
她去年拿到化學學士學位。
When will you *come back* from Japan?
你什麼時候從日本回來？
Lie *on your back* and relax.
仰躺著放輕鬆。
Please use the *back door* after six o'clock.
六點以後請走後門。
Volunteers are *the backbone of* the school's reading program.
志工是學校閱讀計畫的骨幹。
He didn't *have the backbone to* tell the truth.
他沒有勇氣說出真相。
Students in our class come from very different *family backgrounds*.
我們班的學生來自非常不同的家庭背景。
The company asked about my *educational background* in the interview.
那家公司在面試時問了我的學歷。
Soft *background music* was playing in the coffee shop.
咖啡店裡播放著輕柔的背景音樂。
Many students *carry a backpack* full of books.
很多學生揹著一個裝滿書的背包。
*Pack your backpack* the night before school.

希臘常被稱為西方文化的發源地。

collocs.c: from the cradle to the grave
ex: Some countries take care of people *from the cradle to the grave*.
有些國家從出生到死亡都照顧人民。
The kids made paper lanterns in *arts and crafts* class.
孩子們在美勞課上做了紙燈籠。
We sold handmade bookmarks at the weekend *craft fair*.
我們在週末的手作市集賣手工書籤。
Many students *cram for the exam* the night before.
很多學生在考前一晚臨時抱佛腳。
She goes to a *cram school* three evenings a week.
她一週有三個晚上去補習班。
Twenty people *crammed into* the small MRT car at rush hour.
尖峰時段有二十個人擠進那節小小的捷運車廂。
Drink enough water or you might *get a cramp* while running.
要喝夠水，不然跑步時可能會抽筋。

她吃了那個不新鮮的壽司後，肚子絞痛得很厲害。

我們伸長脖子想看清楚台上的歌手。

他去年在一場車禍中摔斷了腿。
Amazingly, all six people survived the small *plane crash*.
令人驚訝的是，那場小飛機墜機事故中六個人全都生還。
A scooter *crashed into* the back of the bus.
一台機車撞上了公車的尾部。
The lake was formed inside an old *volcanic crater*.
那座湖是在一個古老的火山口裡形成的。
Scientists found a huge *impact crater* left by a meteor.
科學家發現了一個由隕石留下的巨大撞擊坑。
On Saturday night, the night market *was crawling with* tourists.
星期六晚上，夜市裡擠滿了觀光客。
Traffic *slowed to a crawl* because of the heavy rain.
因為大雨，車流慢得像在爬。
My little sister got *a box of crayons* for her birthday.
我妹妹生日時收到一盒蠟筆。
The kids like to *draw with crayons* after lunch.
孩子們喜歡在午餐後用蠟筆畫畫。

我哥哥很迷籃球，每天都打。

考試前我的手機壞掉，我差點抓狂。

晚上樓上的噪音快把我逼瘋了。

搭完捷運我們去吃冰淇淋吧。

她在蛋糕上面加了打發的鮮奶油。
My mom always keeps *hand cream* in her bag in winter.
冬天我媽媽包包裡總是放著護手霜。

上課用手機會給大家造成問題。

你要先建立帳號才能上線上課程。

新工廠會為我們鎮上很多人創造工作機會。

新工廠將有助於在鎮上創造就業機會。

這個社團自創立以來已經成長到五十名成員。

這堂暑期課透過遊戲和畫畫教創意思考。
She joined a *creative writing* club to write short stories.
她加入創意寫作社去寫短篇故事。
Our art teacher *encourages creativity* rather than copying.
我們的美術老師鼓勵創意，而不是模仿。
Writing stories helps children develop *creativity and imagination*.
寫故事有助於孩子培養創造力和想像力。

地球上的每一種生物都需要水才能生存。

新聞報導應該以可靠的來源為依據。

警方找不到對那名男子不利的可信證據。

他把這個專案的功勞攬在自己身上，但工作是我們大家一起做的。

你得稱讚她這麼努力。

我爸爸在超市通常用信用卡付款。

隨著考試逼近，疑慮開始悄悄浮現。

一位機組人員幫一位老太太提行李箱。

在印度和英國，很多人喜歡打板球。

他因為犯罪而被送進監獄。

偷車在每個國家都是嚴重的犯罪。

這個城市的犯罪率很低。

有犯罪紀錄的人可能很難找到工作。

警方仍在調查這起刑事案件。

去年冬天機場因大雪而癱瘓。

生意失敗後，這家人背負著沉重的債務。
Many people lost their jobs during the *economic crisis*.
經濟危機期間很多人失去了工作。

那家小公司失去最大的客戶後陷入危機。

節省用電可以幫助我們避免能源危機。

我奶奶做的烤豬肉外皮非常酥脆。

只有三名學生符合獎學金的標準。

選拔標準包括成績、面試和社團活動。

那位影評人只給這部新電影兩顆星。
My dad is *a harsh critic* of fast food.
我爸對速食批評得很嚴厲。
Debate class helps students build *critical thinking* skills.
辯論課幫助學生培養批判性思考的能力。
Bees play *a critical role* in growing fruit.
蜜蜂在水果生長中扮演關鍵角色。
The driver is still in the hospital *in critical condition*.
那名駕駛仍在醫院，情況危急。
A good leader can *accept criticism* without getting angry.
好的領導者能接受批評而不生氣。
Our teacher always gives *constructive criticism* on our essays.
我們的老師總是對我們的作文給予建設性的意見。
The company *faced criticism* for polluting the river.
那家公司因汙染河川而遭到批評。

球迷批評教練太晚換人。

票價調漲在網路上遭到廣泛批評。

別相信他，那只是假裝難過而已。
Farmers here *grow crops* such as rice and sweet potatoes.
這裡的農夫種植稻米和地瓜等農作物。

漫長的乾季導致許多村莊農作物歉收。

過馬路前要先看看兩邊。
We took a small boat to *cross the river*.
我們搭小船過河。
*Cross out* the wrong answer and write the right one.
把錯的答案劃掉，寫上正確的。
The bus waited at the *railroad crossing* for the train to pass.
公車在平交道前等火車通過。
There was a long line at the *border crossing*.
邊境關口排了很長的隊伍。
*A crowd of people* waited outside the MRT station.
一群人在捷運站外面等著。
*A large crowd* came to watch the school basketball game.
一大群人來看學校的籃球比賽。
Everyone *crowded into* the small classroom to see the show.
大家都擠進小教室看表演。
The night market is always *crowded with* tourists on Saturday.
星期六夜市總是擠滿觀光客。

我得在擁擠的列車上一路站回家。

那位年輕王子在十二歲時被加冕為國王。
Our school team *was crowned champion* of the city tournament.
我們校隊榮獲全市錦標賽冠軍。

父母在孩子的教育中扮演關鍵角色。

乾淨的水對社區的健康極為重要。

在關鍵時刻，我們的守門員做出了精彩的撲救。

原油價格會影響我們加油要付多少錢。

老師要他別在課堂上講粗俗的笑話。
You should never *be cruel to* animals.
你絕對不應該對動物殘忍。
Laughing at his weight was *a cruel joke*.
嘲笑他的體重是很殘忍的玩笑。
The news report about *cruelty to animals* made many people angry.
那則虐待動物的新聞讓很多人很憤怒。
Leaving a dog in a hot car is *an act of cruelty*.
把狗留在高溫的車裡是殘忍的行為。
We are planning to *go on a cruise* after graduation.
我們打算畢業後去搭郵輪旅遊。

一艘巨大的郵輪今天早上抵達基隆港。

我喜歡新鮮小黃瓜脆脆的口感。

大家都知道他暗戀班上新來的女生。
The shaved ice shop adds *crushed ice* to every drink.
那家冰店的每杯飲料都加碎冰。
She came back to school *on crutches* after the accident.
車禍後她拄著拐杖回到學校。
The nurse gave him *a pair of crutches* before he left.
他離開前，護理師給了他一副拐杖。
The baby *started to cry* when the lights went out.
燈一熄，寶寶就開始哭了。
We heard someone *cry for help* near the river.
我們聽到河邊有人在呼救。
Don't *cry over* one bad test score.
別為了一次考差就哭。

ex: The water at the beach in Kenting was *crystal clear*.
墾丁海灘的海水清澈見底。
Tiny *ice crystals* covered the car windows on the cold morning.
那個寒冷的早晨，車窗上布滿了細小的冰晶。
The zoo welcomed a new *bear cub* last spring.
動物園去年春天迎來了一隻新的小熊。
The *lion cub* played with its mother's tail.
小獅子在玩媽媽的尾巴。
Put a few *ice cubes* in my lemonade, please.
請在我的檸檬汁裡放幾顆冰塊。
She dropped a *sugar cube* into her black tea.
她把一顆方糖丟進紅茶裡。
Even during the hard exam, she stayed *as cool as a cucumber*.
即使在很難的考試中，她依然非常冷靜。

這份沙拉附有番茄和小黃瓜片。

我們正在聊班，他就剛好走了進來。

品嚐當地美食是我旅行時最喜歡的部分。

培養規律運動的習慣需要時間。

好老師會和學生建立信任的關係。
Farmers here have *cultivated the land* for hundreds of years.
這裡的農民已經耕種這片土地好幾百年了。

老師談到台灣和日本之間的文化差異。

這個城市在元宵節期間舉辦很多文化活動。

旅行是了解當地文化的好方法。

划龍舟是中華文化的一部分。

很多學生從美國流行文化中學英文。

小小的儲蓄經過多年會產生很大的累積效應。

今年遊客的累計總數超過了一百萬人。

小偷想出一個狡猾的計畫潛入博物館。

請自備水壺，不要用紙杯。

廚房櫥櫃裡有一些餅乾。

政府升息以抑制通貨膨脹。

我爸媽決定減少外食的開銷。

新法規限制了塑膠袋的使用。

科學家正在努力找出治癒這種疾病的方法。

出於好奇，我第一次嘗試臭豆腐。

大部分大型銀行都可以兌換外幣。

旅行時用當地貨幣付款比較划算。

機場出口附近有一個貨幣兌換櫃台。
We read news about *current events* in English class.
我們在英文課上讀時事新聞。
The teacher explained the *current situation* to our parents.
老師向我們的家長說明了目前的情況。
Don't swim here because there is a *strong current*.
別在這裡游泳，因為水流很強。
Coding is now part of the *school curriculum* in Taiwan.
程式設計現在已經是台灣學校課程的一部分。
The *national curriculum* sets what students learn in each grade.
全國課程綱要規定了各年級學生要學的內容。

咖哩飯是台灣最受歡迎的午餐之一。

故事裡，一個女巫對年輕的王子下了詛咒。

我媽媽拉開窗簾讓陽光照進來。

請拉上窗簾，這樣我們才看得到螢幕。
The bus slowed down before *a sharp curve* in the mountains.
公車在山上的急彎前減速。
The road *curves to the left* after the bridge.
過橋之後，路向左彎。

額外的獎金幫他減輕了失業的打擊。

好的跑鞋能減輕對膝蓋的衝擊。

那名酒駕司機在車禍後立刻被拘留。

在家脫鞋是這裡的當地習俗。

我們家遵循秋天吃月餅的習俗。

通關之後，你就可以領行李了。

海關人員要求檢查我的行李箱。

媽媽把蘋果切成兩半給我和弟弟。

新學年開始前我把頭髮剪短了。

他做菜時手指被割了一道很深的傷口。

我的鄰居有一隻叫 Lucky 的可愛小狗。

你戴那頂帽子看起來很可愛。

我們在自然課學到蝴蝶的生命週期。

我表哥每天騎腳踏車上學。

有些學生對學校的新規定抱持懷疑。

牛奶、起司和優格都是乳製品。

政府計畫在這條河上建一座水壩。

颱風對很多房子造成了損害。

地震對那座老橋造成嚴重的損害。

晚餐後用濕布擦桌子。
*Damp weather* in spring makes our clothes take forever to dry.
春天潮濕的天氣讓衣服一直乾不了。
Everyone began to *dance to the music* at the party.
派對上大家開始隨著音樂跳舞。
My sister goes to *dance class* every Saturday.
我妹妹每個星期六都去上舞蹈課。
He joined the *street dance* club at school.
他參加了學校的街舞社。
My cousin is *a good dancer* and won a school contest.
我表姊很會跳舞，還贏了學校比賽。
She wants to become a *ballet dancer* when she grows up.
她長大後想成為芭蕾舞者。
Call 119 if someone is *in danger*.
如果有人有危險，就打 119。
The doctor said my grandpa was *out of danger*.
醫生說我爺爺已經脫離危險了。
It's *dangerous to* ride a scooter without a helmet.
騎機車不戴安全帽很危險。
The old building is *a dangerous place* for kids to play.
那棟舊大樓對孩子來說是危險的玩耍地點。
Few students *dare to ask* questions in that teacher's class.
在那位老師的課上，很少有學生敢發問。
*How dare you* read my diary without asking!
你竟敢沒問我就看我的日記！

collocs.zh: 我諒你不敢；我賭你不敢
ex: *I dare you* to eat this whole chili pepper.
我賭你不敢把這整根辣椒吃掉。
It *gets dark* early in winter.
冬天天黑得早。
My little brother is afraid to sleep *in the dark*.
我弟弟怕在黑暗中睡覺。
Our school uniform is *dark blue*.
我們的校服是深藍色的。
"Good night, *my darling*," Grandma said with a smile.
「晚安，我親愛的。」奶奶笑著說。
When the rain started, we *made a dash for* the bus stop.
開始下雨時，我們朝公車站衝過去。
She *dashed off* to her cram school right after class.
她一下課就匆匆趕去補習班。
Our class *collected data* about how much students sleep.
我們班收集了學生睡眠時間的資料。
My cousin studies *data analysis* in college.
我表哥在大學讀資料分析。
Never share your *personal data* with strangers online.
千萬不要在網路上把個人資料給陌生人。
Our teacher showed us how to use an *online database* for research.
老師教我們如何使用線上資料庫做研究。
The club *built a database* of all its members.
社團建立了一個所有社員的資料庫。
My older sister *went on a date* last Saturday.
我姊姊上星期六去約會了。
The *due date* for the report is next Friday.
報告的截止日期是下星期五。
Write your name and *date of birth* on the form.
請在表格上寫下你的姓名和出生日期。
She is the *only daughter* in her family.
她是家裡唯一的女兒。
As the *eldest daughter*, she often takes care of her brothers.
身為長女，她常常照顧弟弟們。
We got up *at dawn* to watch the sunrise on Alishan.
我們在黎明時起床看阿里山的日出。
The farmers work *from dawn till dusk* during harvest time.
收成期間農夫們從早工作到晚。
I studied *all day* for the final exam.
我為了期末考讀了一整天的書。
*One day* I want to travel around the world.
有一天我想環遊世界。
The bus driver smiled and said, "*Have a nice day*!"
公車司機笑著說：「祝你有美好的一天！」
Tourists *are dazzled by* the city lights at night.
遊客們被夜晚的城市燈光迷住了。
The singer greeted her fans with a *dazzling smile*.
那位歌手以燦爛的笑容迎接粉絲。
We swept the *dead leaves* off the playground.
我們把操場上的枯葉掃乾淨。
My phone has a *dead battery*, so I can't call you.
我的手機沒電了，所以不能打給你。
I stayed up late to *meet the deadline* for my essay.
我熬夜趕在期限前交作文。
If you *miss the deadline*, you can't apply for the program.
如果你錯過期限，就不能申請這個計畫。
We finished the video on *a tight deadline*.
我們在緊迫的期限內完成了影片。
Scientists are working on a vaccine for the *deadly disease*.
科學家正在研發對抗這種致命疾病的疫苗。
In the wrong hands, a kitchen knife can be a *deadly weapon*.
落入壞人手中，菜刀也可能成為致命武器。
He was *deadly serious* when he said he wanted to be a pilot.
他說想當飛行員的時候，態度非常認真。
Listening to very loud music can make you *go deaf*.
聽很大聲的音樂可能會讓你變聾。
Some *deaf people* use sign language to talk.
有些聽障人士用手語溝通。
The fireworks made a *deafening noise* above the river.
煙火在河面上方發出震耳欲聾的聲響。
After the bad news, there was a *deafening silence* in the room.
壞消息傳來後，房間裡一片死寂。
I don't know how to *deal with* so much homework.
我不知道怎麼應付這麼多作業。
Two drinks for 50 dollars is *a good deal*.
兩杯飲料五十元很划算。
My brother and I *made a deal* to share the computer.
我和哥哥說好要輪流用電腦。
The *car dealer* offered us a free test drive.
那位汽車經銷商讓我們免費試駕。
The police arrested a *drug dealer* near the train station.
警方在火車站附近逮捕了一名毒販。
*Oh dear*, I left my umbrella on the MRT.
糟糕，我把雨傘忘在捷運上了。
She has been *a dear friend* since elementary school.
她從小學起就是我很要好的朋友。

collocs.c: a matter of life and death
ex: Wearing a seat belt can be *a matter of life and death*.
繫安全帶可能攸關生死。
I was *bored to death* during the long meeting.
那場冗長的會議讓我無聊死了。
She joined the English *debate team* at her high school.
她加入了高中的英文辯論隊。
We *had a debate* about school uniforms in class.
我們在課堂上針對校服進行辯論。
Students *debated about* whether phones should be allowed in class.
學生們辯論上課是否應該允許用手機。
*Space debris* can damage satellites that move around the Earth.
太空垃圾可能損壞繞行地球的人造衛星。
Stay indoors during the storm to avoid *flying debris*.
暴風雨期間待在室內，以免被飛散的碎片打到。
He was *in debt* after buying an expensive car.
他買了一輛貴的車之後就負債了。
It took my uncle five years to *pay off his debt*.
我叔叔花了五年才還清債務。
The singer *made her debut* on a TV talent show at sixteen.
那位歌手十六歲時在電視選秀節目上首次亮相。
The band's *debut album* sold very well in Taiwan and Japan.
這個樂團的首張專輯在台灣和日本都賣得很好。
This noodle shop has been open *for decades*.
這家麵店已經開了幾十年。
Online shopping has grown quickly *over the past decade*.
網路購物在過去十年間成長得很快。
Drinking too many sugary drinks can cause *tooth decay*.
喝太多含糖飲料可能導致蛀牙。
The old train station *fell into decay* after the new one opened.
新車站啟用後，舊車站就逐漸荒廢了。
The fake website *deceived people into* giving away their passwords.
那個假網站騙人交出了自己的密碼。
Many older people *were deceived by* the phone scam.
許多長者被這個電話詐騙騙了。
Our school has a Christmas party *in December*.
我們學校在十二月會辦聖誕派對。
My brother finally found *a decent job* after graduation.
我哥畢業後終於找到一份像樣的工作。
She *makes a decent living* by teaching piano lessons.
她靠教鋼琴過著不錯的生活。
I *decided to* join the basketball club this year.
我決定今年參加籃球社。
We can't *decide on* a place for the class trip.
我們無法決定校外教學要去哪裡。
We need to *make a decision* before Friday.
我們得在星期五前做決定。
Choosing a school is *an important decision*.
選學校是一個重要的決定。
Leaving the team was *a difficult decision* for her.
離開球隊對她來說是個艱難的決定。
Parents play a *decisive role* in their children's education.
父母在孩子的教育中扮演決定性的角色。
The government must take *decisive action* to fight air pollution.
政府必須採取果斷的行動對抗空氣污染。
The team won a *decisive victory* over last year's champions.
這支隊伍大勝去年的冠軍隊。
Bring *a deck of cards* so we can play on the train.
帶一副撲克牌，我們可以在火車上玩。
Passengers were not allowed *on deck* during the storm.
暴風雨期間，乘客不准到甲板上。
In history class, we read parts of the *Declaration of Independence*.
歷史課上，我們讀了美國獨立宣言的部分內容。
Please fill out the *customs declaration* before the plane lands.
請在飛機降落前填好海關申報單。
The mayor *declared war on* illegal parking in the city.
市長向市區的違規停車宣戰。
At customs, I told the officer I had *nothing to declare*.
在海關，我告訴海關人員我沒有需要申報的物品。
The store saw a *sharp decline* in sales during the pandemic.
疫情期間這家店的業績急遽下滑。
She politely *declined the invitation* because she had to study.
她因為要讀書而禮貌地婉拒了邀請。
The number of smokers in Taiwan is *on the decline*.
台灣的吸菸人數正在減少。
We *decorated the classroom with* balloons.
我們用氣球布置教室。
My family *decorates the Christmas tree* together every year.
我們全家每年一起裝飾聖誕樹。
The mall put up its *Christmas decorations* in early November.
購物中心在十一月初就掛上了聖誕裝飾。
We stayed after school to *put up decorations* for the party.
我們放學後留下來為派對布置裝飾。
There was a *decrease in* the number of students this year.
今年學生人數減少了。
The price of eggs *decreased by* ten percent.
雞蛋的價格下降了百分之十。
This museum *is dedicated to* the history of Taiwanese railways.
這間博物館專門介紹台灣鐵路的歷史。
The band *dedicated a song to* all the teachers in the audience.
樂團把一首歌獻給在場所有的老師。
The nurse was praised for her *dedication to* her patients.
那位護理師因為全心照顧病人而受到讚揚。
His success came from years of *hard work and dedication*.
他的成功來自多年的努力與投入。
The fee will be *deducted from* your monthly salary.
這筆費用會從你的月薪中扣除。
Judges will *deduct points* for any mistakes in the routine.
評審會針對動作中的任何失誤扣分。
Try to do one *good deed* every day.
試著每天做一件好事。
The principal *deemed it necessary* to cancel the school trip.
校長認為有必要取消校外教學。
The plan *was deemed to be* too expensive.
這個計畫被認為太昂貴了。
Take a *deep breath* before you start your speech.
開始演講前先深呼吸。
My dad was in a *deep sleep* and didn't hear the phone.
我爸爸睡得很熟，沒聽到電話。
The small house is *deep in the forest*.
那間小屋在森林深處。
Field trips can *deepen students' understanding* of history.
校外教學能加深學生對歷史的了解。
Working on the project together *deepened our friendship*.
一起做這個專題加深了我們的友誼。
We saw *a herd of deer* in the park in Nara.
我們在奈良的公園裡看到一群鹿。
The app saves your photos to the cloud *by default*.
這個應用程式預設會把照片存到雲端。
If the computer acts strangely, go back to the *default settings*.
如果電腦運作怪怪的，就恢復預設設定。
Many families *defaulted on their loans* during the crisis.
危機期間，許多家庭拖欠了貸款。
Our basketball team *suffered a defeat* in the first round.
我們的籃球隊在第一輪就吃了敗仗。
After trying for an hour, I *admitted defeat* and asked for help.
試了一個小時後，我認輸並請人幫忙。
Smoking during pregnancy can cause a *birth defect*.
懷孕期間抽菸可能導致先天缺陷。
Engineers found a *defect in* the new software.
工程師在新軟體中發現了一個缺陷。
She took a class to learn how to *defend herself*.
她去上課學習如何保護自己。
The thick walls helped the old city *defend against* attacks.
厚厚的城牆幫助古城抵禦攻擊。
The champion hopes to *defend her title* next year.
這位冠軍希望明年能衛冕。
*The defendant pleaded guilty* and said he was sorry.
被告認罪，並表示很抱歉。
*The defendant's lawyer* asked the court for more time.
被告的律師請求法院給予更多時間。
She wrote a letter *in defense of* the school's old library.
她寫了一封信為學校的舊圖書館發聲。
My sister is taking a *self-defense* class at the gym.
我姐姐在健身房上防身術課。
The government plans to spend more on *national defense*.
政府計畫增加國防支出。
Using facts gave our team *a defensible position* in the debate.
運用事實讓我們隊在辯論中有站得住腳的立場。
He *gets defensive* whenever someone comments on his grades.
每當有人提到他的成績，他就急著辯解。
The reporter's questions put the manager *on the defensive*.
記者的問題讓經理處於守勢。
They held the march *in defiance of* the police order.
他們不顧警方命令舉行了遊行。
Refusing to wear the uniform was an *act of defiance*.
拒絕穿制服是一種反抗的行為。
The government plans to cut spending to reduce the *budget deficit*.
政府計畫削減支出來減少預算赤字。
The country's *trade deficit* grew because it imported more oil.
那個國家因為進口更多石油，貿易逆差擴大了。
Can you *define the word* "honest" in English?
你可以用英文解釋「honest」這個字嗎？
The dictionary *defines a friend as* someone you trust.
字典把朋友定義為你信任的人。
We need *a definite answer* about the trip by Friday.
我們需要在星期五前得到關於旅行的明確答覆。
I don't have any *definite plans* for the summer yet.
我暑假還沒有確定的計畫。
A good friend, *by definition*, is someone you can trust.
好朋友本來就是你可以信任的人。
The *dictionary definition* didn't help me understand the word.
字典上的定義沒有幫助我理解這個字。
The doctor couldn't give a *definitive answer* until the test results came back.
檢查結果出來之前，醫生無法給出確切答案。
This book is the *definitive guide* to birds in Taiwan.
這本書是台灣鳥類的權威指南。
The dancers seemed to *defy gravity* with their high jumps.
舞者們高高躍起，彷彿不受地心引力影響。
The view from the top of Jade Mountain *defies description*.
玉山山頂的景色美得難以形容。
It was 35 *degrees Celsius* in Taipei yesterday.
台北昨天攝氏 35 度。
My cousin got a *college degree* in art.
我表哥拿到了藝術的大學學位。
*To some degree*, the test was easier than I expected.
在某種程度上，這次考試比我想的簡單。
Please send me the report *without delay*.
請立刻把報告寄給我。
Our flight *was delayed* because of the typhoon.
我們的班機因為颱風而延誤了。
A good team leader knows how to *delegate tasks* to others.
好的組長懂得如何把工作分派給別人。
The manager learned to *delegate responsibility* to her staff.
那位經理學會把責任下放給員工。
A *trade delegation* came to Taipei to discuss business deals.
一個貿易代表團來台北洽談生意。
Our principal will *lead a delegation* of students to Korea.
我們校長將率領學生代表團前往韓國。
The fake news was a *deliberate attempt* to confuse voters.
這則假新聞是蓄意要混淆選民。
Taking a gap year was a *deliberate decision*, not a mistake.
休學一年是深思熟慮後的決定，不是失誤。
There is *a delicate balance* between school and part-time work.
課業和打工之間要保持微妙的平衡。
My two best friends stopped talking, which put me in *a delicate situation*.
我兩個最好的朋友不講話了，讓我陷入很微妙棘手的處境。
Babies have *delicate skin*, so use a gentle soap.
嬰兒的肌膚很嬌嫩，所以要用溫和的肥皂。
The night market has a lot of *delicious food*.
夜市有很多好吃的東西。
The beef noodles in this shop *smell delicious*.
這家店的牛肉麵聞起來好香。
*To my delight*, my favorite band is coming to Taipei.
令我高興的是，我最喜歡的樂團要來台北了。
My grandpa *takes delight in* teaching us old card games.
我爺爺很喜歡教我們玩古早的紙牌遊戲。
We *are delighted to* welcome our new exchange students.
我們很高興歡迎新的交換學生。
The free dessert at the end of dinner was *a delightful surprise*.
晚餐最後送上的免費甜點真是個驚喜。
Staying with a host family was *a delightful experience*.
住在寄宿家庭是一次愉快的經驗。
The mailman *delivered a package* to our house today.
郵差今天送了一個包裹到我們家。
This shop can *deliver food* to your home in 30 minutes.
這家店可以在三十分鐘內把食物送到你家。
This online store offers *free delivery* on weekends.
這家網路商店週末免運費。
We ordered *food delivery* because it was raining.
因為下雨，我們叫了外送。
Prices go up and down because of *supply and demand*.
價格會因為供需而漲跌。
Nurses are always *in demand* in big hospitals.
大醫院一直很需要護理師。
The bakery hired more workers to *meet the demand* for mooncakes.
麵包店多請了員工以應付月餅的需求。
*In a democracy*, everyone has the right to speak freely.
在民主社會中，每個人都有言論自由的權利。
Many people *fought for democracy* in the 1980s.
1980年代有許多人為民主而奮鬥。
Taiwan is a *democratic country* with free elections.
台灣是一個有自由選舉的民主國家。
In a *democratic society*, the media must be free.
在民主社會中，媒體必須是自由的。
The study *demonstrates that* a good night's sleep helps memory.
這項研究證明一夜好眠有助於記憶。
Thousands of people *demonstrated against* the new tax.
數千人示威反對新稅。
The coach *gave a demonstration* of the correct swimming stroke.
教練示範了正確的游泳姿勢。
Farmers *held a demonstration* outside the government building.
農民在政府大樓外舉行示威。
He is still *in denial* about failing the driving test.
他到現在還不肯接受自己駕照考試沒過。
The *denial of* his visa meant he couldn't attend the conference.
他的簽證被拒，意味著他無法出席會議。
Flights were delayed because of *dense fog* this morning.
今天早上班機因濃霧而延誤。
Taipei is one of the most *densely populated* cities in Asia.
台北是亞洲人口最稠密的城市之一。
Taipei has one of the highest *population densities* in Asia.
台北是亞洲人口密度最高的城市之一。
This area has a *high density* of convenience stores.
這一區的便利商店密度很高。
Good *dental care* starts with brushing twice a day.
良好的牙齒保健從每天刷兩次牙開始。
Use *dental floss* to clean between your teeth.
用牙線清潔牙縫。
There is a *dental clinic* right next to the MRT station.
捷運站旁邊就有一間牙醫診所。
I *go to the dentist* twice a year.
我一年看兩次牙醫。
I have a *dentist appointment* after school today.
我今天放學後有預約看牙醫。
He *denied taking* my eraser, but I saw him.
他否認拿了我的橡皮擦，但我看到了。
You can't *deny the fact* that you were late again.
你無法否認你又遲到的事實。
Our tour bus will *depart from* the school gate at seven.
我們的遊覽車七點從校門口出發。
The team *departed for* Japan early this morning.
球隊今天一早出發前往日本。
My sister studies in the *English department* at her university.
我姊姊在大學念英文系。
My mom works in the *sales department* of a big company.
我媽媽在一家大公司的業務部工作。
We *went to the department store* to buy new shoes.
我們去百貨公司買新鞋。
My mom bought a new bag *at the department store*.
我媽媽在百貨公司買了一個新包包。
The *departure time* of our flight was changed to noon.
我們班機的起飛時間改到中午了。
We ran to the *departure gate* just before it closed.
我們在登機門關閉前跑到了那裡。
Little kids *depend on* their parents for everything.
小孩子凡事都依靠父母。
"Are you going to the party?" "*It depends.*"

Night market stalls must follow strict *food hygiene* rules.
夜市攤位必須遵守嚴格的食品衛生規定。
Good *oral hygiene* means brushing twice a day.
良好的口腔衛生就是一天刷兩次牙。
She felt like *a total hypocrite* for eating junk food after the lecture.
聽完演講後還吃垃圾食物，她覺得自己是十足的偽君子。
We did an experiment to *test our hypothesis* in science class.
我們在自然課上做實驗來驗證我們的假設。
Sadly, the results of our experiment did not *support the hypothesis*.
可惜的是，我們的實驗結果並不支持這個假設。
I finished the whole puzzle *by myself*.
我自己一個人完成了整個拼圖。
*A friend of mine* lives near Taipei 101.
我的一個朋友住在台北101附近。
Can I have some *ice cubes* in my drink?
我的飲料可以加些冰塊嗎？
I'd like a black tea with *less ice*, please.
我要一杯少冰的紅茶，謝謝。
My brother dropped his *ice cream cone* on the floor.
我弟弟把他的冰淇淋甜筒掉在地上。
*Chocolate ice cream* is my favorite dessert.
巧克力冰淇淋是我最愛的甜點。
These reported cases are only *the tip of the iceberg*.
這些通報的案例只是冰山一角。
Taipei 101 is a *cultural icon* of the city.
台北101是這座城市的文化象徵。
*Click on the icon* at the top to save your work.
點選上方的圖示來儲存你的作品。
Several cars slid off the *icy road* last night.
昨晚有好幾輛車在結冰的路面上滑出路外。
An *icy wind* blew across the beach in January.
一月時，刺骨的寒風吹過海灘。
It's *a good idea* to review your notes before bed.
睡前複習筆記是個好主意。
I *have no idea* where my phone is.
我不知道我的手機在哪裡。
She *came up with an idea* for our class project.
她為我們的班級專題想出一個點子。
The library is *an ideal place* to study.
圖書館是讀書的理想地方。
This park *is ideal for* a family picnic.
這座公園很適合全家野餐。
The *identical twins* in my class often fool the teachers.
我們班那對同卵雙胞胎常常騙過老師。
Your phone case is *identical to* mine.
你的手機殼跟我的一模一樣。
Please bring *proof of identification* to the exam.
考試時請攜帶身分證明。
Don't forget your *identification card* when you vote.
投票時別忘了帶身分證。
First, we need to *identify the problem*.
首先我們必須找出問題所在。
Many teens *identify with* the main character.
許多青少年對主角很有共鳴。
The police *identified the man as* a local farmer.
警方確認那名男子是當地的一位農夫。
You need your *identity card* to open a bank account.
你開銀行帳戶需要身分證。
Food is an important part of our *cultural identity*.
食物是我們文化認同的重要部分。
Friends can stay close even with different *political ideologies*.
即使政治理念不同，朋友仍然可以保持親近。
She used a *Chinese idiom* to explain the story.
她用一句中文成語來解釋這個故事。
I *felt like an idiot* when I forgot my lines on stage.
我在台上忘詞時覺得自己像個笨蛋。
He made me look like a *complete idiot* in front of everyone.
他讓我在大家面前看起來像個十足的笨蛋。
Don't let your new bike *sit idle* in the garage.
別讓你的新腳踏車閒置在車庫裡。
He *idled away* the whole summer playing games.
他整個暑假都在打電動中虛度了。
She dreams of becoming a *pop idol* one day.
她夢想有一天成為流行偶像。
The actor was a *teen idol* in the nineties.
那位演員在九〇年代是青少年偶像。
He talks *as if* he knows everything.
他說話的樣子好像什麼都懂。
*If possible*, please send me the notes tonight.
可以的話，請今晚把筆記傳給我。
*Ignorance of* the law is no excuse.
不知法律不能當作藉口。
He made the rude joke *out of ignorance*, not hate.
他開那個無禮的玩笑是出於無知，而不是仇恨。
Many people are *ignorant of* the dangers of smoking.
許多人不知道抽菸的危險。
If you *ignore the problem*, it will only get worse.
如果你忽視這個問題，它只會更糟。
He *ignored my advice* and stayed up all night.
他不聽我的建議，熬夜了一整晚。
She *fell ill* the day before the trip.
她在旅行前一天生病了。
His grandmother is *seriously ill* in the hospital.
他奶奶病得很重，正在住院。
The *brightly illuminated* night market attracts tourists every evening.
燈火通明的夜市每晚都吸引觀光客。
The new study helps *illuminate the problem* of teen sleep loss.
這項新研究有助於闡明青少年睡眠不足的問題。
The picture is an *optical illusion*; the lines are the same length.
這張圖是視覺錯覺，那些線其實一樣長。
He was *under the illusion that* he could pass without studying.
他誤以為不用讀書也能及格。
Bright colors *create an illusion* of space in small apartments.
明亮的顏色能在小公寓裡製造空間寬敞的錯覺。
Let me use an example to *illustrate the point*.
讓我用一個例子來說明這個論點。
The children love this *illustrated book* about animals.
孩子們很喜歡這本有插圖的動物書。
*By way of illustration*, look at the chart on page five.
作為例證，請看第五頁的圖表。
The X-ray gave the doctor *a clear image* of my arm.
X光片讓醫生清楚看到我手臂的影像。
Famous singers care about their *public image*.
知名歌手很在意自己的公眾形象。
Many young kids talk to an *imaginary friend*.
許多小孩會跟假想的朋友說話。
The equator is an *imaginary line* around the earth.
赤道是一條環繞地球的假想線。
The teacher asked us to *use our imagination* and draw a future city.
老師要我們發揮想像力，畫出一座未來城市。

collocs.zh: 吸引某人；激發某人的興趣
ex: Stories about space travel have always *captured my imagination*.
太空旅行一直深深吸引著我。
The group came up with an *imaginative idea* for the poster.
這組為海報想出一個很有創意的點子。
Can you *imagine living* on the moon?
你能想像住在月球上嗎？
I *can't imagine* life without my phone.
我無法想像沒有手機的生活。
The bird can *imitate the sound* of a ringing phone.
那隻鳥會模仿電話鈴響的聲音。
The bag looks real, but it's *imitation leather*.
這個包包看起來很像真的，但其實是人造皮。
She can *do an imitation of* any cartoon character.
她能模仿任何一個卡通人物。
The school took *immediate action* after the fire alarm went off.
火災警報響起後，學校立刻採取行動。
Only *immediate family* members can visit the patient.
只有直系親屬可以探視這位病人。
Students in their senior year are under *immense pressure*.
高三學生承受著極大的壓力。
These old letters are of *immense value* to historians.
這些舊信件對歷史學家來說有極大的價值。
The report discussed the number of *illegal immigrants*.
這份報告討論了非法移民的人數。
The school offers language classes for *new immigrants*.
學校為新住民開設語言課程。
My uncle wants to *immigrate to* New Zealand after he retires.
我舅舅退休後想移民到紐西蘭。
The government changed its *immigration policy* last year.
政府去年改變了移民政策。
It took us thirty minutes to *go through immigration*.
我們花了三十分鐘才通過入境審查。
The villagers were in *imminent danger* from the rising river.
上漲的河水讓村民面臨迫在眉睫的危險。
Officials said the typhoon posed an *imminent threat* to the east coast.
官員表示颱風對東海岸構成迫切的威脅。
Enough sleep helps keep your *immune system* strong.
充足的睡眠有助於維持免疫系統強健。
No one is *immune to* criticism, not even the teacher.
沒有人能免於批評，連老師也不例外。
Sleep *has a big impact on* your grades.
睡眠對你的成績有很大的影響。
Plastic has a *negative impact* on sea animals.
塑膠對海洋動物有負面影響。
The glass broke *on impact* with the floor.
玻璃一撞到地板就碎了。
*It is imperative that* everyone leaves the building during the fire drill.
消防演練時所有人都必須離開大樓。
Many feel that protecting the environment is a *moral imperative*.
許多人認為保護環境是道德上的責任。
The Japanese *imperial family* appeared at the New Year event.
日本皇室在新年活動中露面。
In the 1800s, many *imperial powers* fought for control of Asia.
十九世紀時，許多帝國勢力爭奪對亞洲的控制。
The government *implemented a policy* to reduce plastic bags.
政府實施了減少塑膠袋的政策。
It took two years to fully *implement the plan*.
花了兩年才把這個計畫完全執行。
The new law *has implications for* every small business.
這項新法對每一家小型企業都有影響。
He praised her work and, *by implication*, criticized mine.
他稱讚她的作品，言下之意是在批評我的。
A warning was *implicit in* her calm words.
她平靜的話語中隱含著警告。
The players have *implicit trust* in their coach.
球員們對教練有絕對的信任。
Are you *implying that* I cheated on the test?
你是在暗示我考試作弊嗎？
*It's impolite to* talk with your mouth full.
嘴裡塞滿食物時說話是不禮貌的。
He shouldn't *be impolite to* the bus driver.
他不應該對公車司機沒禮貌。
Taiwan *imports oil from* many countries in the Middle East.
台灣從許多中東國家進口石油。
The government announced *a ban on imports* of the fruit.
政府宣布禁止進口這種水果。
Our teacher talked about *the importance of* sleep.
我們老師談到了睡眠的重要性。
This exam is *of great importance* to my future.
這場考試對我的未來非常重要。
*It is important to* drink enough water every day.
每天喝足夠的水是很重要的。
Friends *are important to* me.
朋友對我很重要。
Music is *an important part of* my life.
音樂是我生活中重要的一部分。
The city *imposed a tax on* sugary drinks.
市政府對含糖飲料課稅。
Parents shouldn't *impose their dreams on* their children.
父母不應該把自己的夢想強加在孩子身上。
The school *imposed restrictions* on phone use.
學校對手機使用實施限制。
The old courthouse is an *imposing building* in the city center.
舊法院是市中心一棟雄偉的建築。
Tall and serious, the principal was an *imposing figure*.
校長又高又嚴肅，是個令人敬畏的人物。
*It's impossible to* finish all this homework tonight.
今晚不可能寫完所有作業。
Getting concert tickets is *almost impossible*.
要買到演唱會門票幾乎不可能。
We *were impressed by* how clean the city was.
那座城市之乾淨讓我們印象深刻。
He wore a suit to *try to impress* his girlfriend's parents.
他穿了西裝，想讓女朋友的父母留下好印象。
My *first impression* of the city was very good.
我對這座城市的第一印象非常好。
She *made a strong impression* on the judges.
她讓評審留下深刻的印象。
I was *under the impression that* the test was tomorrow.
我以為考試是明天。
The band gave *an impressive performance* at the school fair.
樂團在園遊會上的表演令人印象深刻。
Your English speech was *really impressive*.
你的英文演講真的很了不起。
The court sentenced the killer to *life imprisonment*.
法院判處那名殺人犯無期徒刑。
He faces up to five *years of imprisonment* for the crime.
他因這項罪行面臨最高五年的徒刑。
Watching movies can help you *improve your English*.
看電影能幫助你增進英文能力。
I study every night to *improve my grades*.
我每天晚上讀書來提高成績。
Her health has *greatly improved* since she started jogging.
她開始慢跑後，健康大幅改善了。
Practice every day to *improve your skills*.
每天練習來提升你的技巧。
You've *made a big improvement* in your writing.
你的寫作有很大的進步。
Your essay is good, but there's still *room for improvement*.
你的作文不錯，但還有進步的空間。
She bought the shoes *on impulse* and regretted it later.
她一時衝動買了那雙鞋，後來很後悔。
I *resisted the impulse* to check my phone during class.
我克制住上課時想看手機的衝動。
Big online sales often lead to a lot of *impulse buying*.
大型網路特賣常常導致許多衝動購物。
I always drink milk *in the morning*.
我早上總是喝牛奶。
Can you say that *in English*?
你可以用英文說嗎？
Let's meet *in front of* the convenience store.
我們在便利商店前面碰面吧。
Lower prices give people an *incentive to* buy electric scooters.
較低的價格給了人們購買電動機車的誘因。
The government offers *tax incentives* to companies that use green energy.
政府為使用綠能的公司提供稅務優惠。
Some parents offer a *financial incentive* for good grades.
有些父母以金錢獎勵好成績。
This plant is about ten *inches tall* now.
這株植物現在大約十英寸高。
The school trip ended *without incident*.
校外教學平安無事地結束了。
The school says the fight was an *isolated incident*.
學校說那場打架只是單一事件。
Teenagers *are inclined to* stay up late on weekends.
青少年週末往往會熬夜。
We pushed our bikes up the *steep incline* to the temple.
我們推著腳踏車爬上通往寺廟的陡坡。
Breakfast *is included in* the hotel price.
飯店價格包含早餐。
Please *include me in* the class group chat.
請把我加進班級群組。
The ticket costs 500 dollars, *including tax*.
票價 500 元，含稅。
The ticket price is *inclusive of* lunch and a guided tour.
票價包含午餐和導覽。
*Inclusive education* lets students with disabilities learn in regular classes.
融合教育讓身心障礙學生在一般班級中學習。
Doctors usually have *a high income*.
醫生通常收入很高。
My mom's new job increased our *family income*.
媽媽的新工作增加了我們的家庭收入。
Try to *incorporate exercise into* your daily routine.
試著把運動納入你的日常作息。
The designer *incorporated ideas* from the students into the new uniform.
設計師把學生的想法融入新制服中。
The price of bubble tea *increased by* ten dollars.
珍珠奶茶的價格漲了十元。
There's been *an increase in* the number of students.
學生人數增加了。
She did an *incredible amount of* work for the festival.
她為園遊會做了驚人的大量工作。
*It's incredible that* he learned to swim in one week.
令人難以置信的是，他一個星期就學會了游泳。
The school *incurred extra costs* for the new air conditioners.
學校為了新冷氣產生了額外費用。
Many students *incur debt* to pay for their college education.
許多學生為了支付大學學費而負債。

collocs.c: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
ex: *A friend in need is a friend indeed*, as Grandma says.
就像奶奶說的，患難見真情。
The country *gained independence* in 1960.
那個國家在1960年獲得獨立。
Living alone gave her *independence from* her parents.
獨自生活讓她不再依賴父母。
I want to *be independent of* my parents someday.
我希望有一天能不依賴父母。
Living in the dorm made her *an independent person*.
住宿舍讓她成為一個獨立的人。
She pointed at the map with her *index finger*.
她用食指指著地圖。
The consumer *price index* rose again this month.
這個月消費者物價指數再度上升。
The results *indicate that* students need more sleep.
結果顯示學生需要更多睡眠。
The signs *clearly indicate* where the MRT exit is.
標示清楚指出捷運出口在哪裡。
The teacher didn't *give any indication* of what would be on the test.
老師沒有透露考試會考什麼。
Rising prices are a *clear indication* of inflation.
物價上漲是通貨膨脹的明確跡象。
The report criticized public *indifference to* the homeless.
這份報告批評大眾對遊民漠不關心。
She shrugged and listened to the news *with indifference*.
她聳聳肩，冷漠地聽著新聞。
Many people are *indifferent to* problems that don't affect them.
許多人對與自己無關的問題漠不關心。
The museum shows the history of Taiwan's *indigenous people*.
這座博物館展示台灣原住民的歷史。
This kind of bird is *indigenous to* Taiwan.
這種鳥是台灣特有的原生種。
Parents were *indignant at* the sudden rise in school fees.
家長對學費突然調漲感到憤慨。
Clean water and good food are *indispensable to* good health.
乾淨的水和好的食物對健康不可或缺。
Music is an *indispensable part* of my life.
音樂是我生活中不可或缺的一部分。
A good teacher pays attention to *individual needs*.
好老師會注意每個學生的個人需求。
*Each individual* should be responsible for their own work.
每個人都應該對自己的工作負責。
On rainy days, the club plans *indoor activities* like board games.
下雨天時，社團會安排桌遊之類的室內活動。
Badminton is one of the most popular *indoor sports* in Taiwan.
羽毛球是台灣最受歡迎的室內運動之一。
Because of the typhoon, everyone was told to *stay indoors*.
因為颱風的關係，大家都被告知要待在室內。
When the air quality got worse, we *went indoors*.
空氣品質變差時，我們就進到室內。
Nothing could *induce him to* eat stinky tofu again.
沒有什麼能讓他再吃一次臭豆腐。
The doctor said her headaches were *stress-induced* before exams.
醫生說她考前的頭痛是壓力引起的。
On weekends, I *indulge in* long naps and comic books.
週末時我盡情享受長長的午覺和漫畫。
You worked hard this month, so *indulge yourself* a little.
你這個月很努力，所以稍微犒賞一下自己吧。
The river was polluted by *industrial waste* from nearby factories.
這條河被附近工廠的工業廢料污染了。
We learned about *the Industrial Revolution* in history class today.
我們今天在歷史課上學到了工業革命。
*Industrialized countries* produce most of the world's carbon emissions.
工業化國家排放了全世界大部分的碳。
Many people in Hsinchu work in *the tech industry*.
新竹有很多人在科技產業工作。
*The tourism industry* is important to Hualien.
觀光產業對花蓮很重要。
*It is inevitable that* you will make mistakes when learning.
學習時犯錯是不可避免的。
Being tired is the *inevitable result* of staying up late.
熬夜的必然結果就是疲累。
*Newborn infants* sleep for most of the day.
新生兒一天大部分時間都在睡覺。
Better hospitals have lowered *infant mortality* in many countries.
較好的醫院降低了許多國家的嬰兒死亡率。
He was *infected with* the flu after the school trip.
校外教學之後他得了流感。
Keep the cut clean, or it may become an *infected wound*.
保持傷口清潔，否則可能會感染。
Washing your hands lowers the *risk of infection*.
洗手能降低感染的風險。
My little brother has an *ear infection* again.
我弟弟又耳朵發炎了。
Doctors wear masks to *prevent infection*.
醫生戴口罩以預防感染。
Doctors are worried about the spread of *infectious diseases* in summer.
醫生擔心夏天傳染病的擴散。
Her *infectious laugh* made the whole class smile.
她有感染力的笑聲讓全班都笑了。
The new teacher's *infectious enthusiasm* made science fun.
新老師有感染力的熱情讓自然課變得有趣。
What can you *infer from* the last paragraph of the article?
你可以從文章的最後一段推斷出什麼？
Try to *infer the meaning* of new words from context.
試著從上下文推斷生字的意思。
This cheap phone is *inferior to* the one I had before.
這支便宜的手機比我之前那支差。
She often *felt inferior* to her older sister.
她常常覺得自己比不上姊姊而感到自卑。
There are an *infinite number* of stars in the universe.
宇宙中有無數的星星。
Our piano teacher has *infinite patience* with beginners.
我們的鋼琴老師對初學者有無比的耐心。
The *rate of inflation* rose to three percent.
通貨膨脹率升到了百分之三。
*High inflation* makes it hard for families to save money.
高通膨讓家庭很難存錢。
The earthquake *inflicted heavy damage on* old buildings.
地震對老舊建築造成嚴重損害。

圖書館外有給學生用的腳踏車架。
The small band stayed *under the radar* for years before becoming famous.
那個小樂團在成名前默默無聞了好幾年。
She gave us a *radiant smile* when she heard the good news.
她聽到好消息時對我們露出燦爛的笑容。
His face was *radiant with* joy after winning the race.
他贏得比賽後臉上洋溢著喜悅。
The sun *radiates heat* and light to the earth.
太陽向地球散發熱和光。
She *radiated confidence* as she gave her speech.
她發表演講時散發著自信。
Many roads *radiate from* the center of the city.
許多道路從市中心向外延伸。
Workers wear special suits to reduce *exposure to radiation*.
工人穿特殊衣服以減少暴露於輻射。
Sunscreen protects your skin from harmful *ultraviolet radiation*.
防曬乳能保護皮膚免受有害紫外線的傷害。
The new principal made *radical changes* to the school schedule.
新校長大幅改變了學校的作息表。
Many people say the education system needs *radical reform*.
許多人說教育制度需要徹底改革。
My dad *listens to the radio* while driving.
我爸爸開車時會聽廣播。
I heard this song *on the radio*.
我在廣播上聽到這首歌。
This *radio station* plays a lot of pop music.
這個廣播電台播很多流行音樂。
Where to store *radioactive waste* is a big debate in Taiwan.
核廢料要存放在哪裡在台灣是一大爭議。
The lab keeps *radioactive material* in a locked room.
實驗室把放射性物質放在上鎖的房間裡。
I ordered fried *radish cake* at the breakfast shop.
我在早餐店點了煎蘿蔔糕。
There are five schools *within a radius of* one kilometer.
方圓一公里內有五所學校。
What is the *radius of a circle* with a diameter of ten?
直徑為十的圓，半徑是多少？

collocs.zh: 從貧窮到致富；白手起家
ex: The movie tells the story of a man who went *from rags to riches*.
這部電影講述一個男人白手起家的故事。
In the story, the poor girl was dressed *in rags*.
在故事裡，那個貧窮的女孩穿得破破爛爛的。
He left the room *in a rage* and slammed the door.
他在盛怒之下離開房間，甩上了門。
*Road rage* causes many accidents on busy highways.
路怒在繁忙的公路上造成許多車禍。
Short videos are *all the rage* among teenagers right now.
短影片現在在青少年之間非常流行。
In the story, the poor boy wore *ragged clothes* all winter.
故事裡那個窮男孩整個冬天都穿著破爛的衣服。
Many old buildings were destroyed in an *air raid* during the war.
許多老建築在戰時的空襲中被摧毀。
My brother always *raids the fridge* after basketball practice.
我弟弟籃球練習後總是去搜刮冰箱。
Traveling *by rail* is a relaxing way to see the east coast.
搭火車旅行是欣賞東海岸的悠閒方式。
It takes about ninety minutes from Taipei to Kaohsiung by *high-speed rail*.
從台北搭高鐵到高雄大約九十分鐘。
Meet me at the *railroad station* at noon.
中午在火車站和我碰面。
Never walk on the *railroad tracks*.
千萬不要走在鐵軌上。
A new *railway line* opened in our city.
我們城市開通了一條新的鐵路線。
We took the *high-speed railway* to Kaohsiung.
我們搭高鐵去高雄。
The *railway station* is very crowded during holidays.
火車站在連假時非常擁擠。
We rode the old *mountain railway* to Alishan.
我們搭老舊的登山鐵路上阿里山。
*Heavy rain* stopped the baseball game.
大雨使棒球比賽停了下來。
We got wet walking home *in the rain*.
我們在雨中走路回家，全身都濕了。
It's *raining hard*, so take an umbrella.
雨下得很大，帶把傘吧。
We saw *a double rainbow* after the storm.
暴風雨過後我們看到了雙彩虹。
Can you name all *the colors of the rainbow*?
你說得出彩虹所有的顏色嗎？
I *wear a raincoat* when I ride my bike in the rain.
下雨天騎腳踏車時我會穿雨衣。
*Put on your raincoat*; it's starting to rain.
穿上雨衣，開始下雨了。
*Heavy rainfall* caused flooding in several towns last night.
豪雨昨晚在數個鄉鎮造成淹水。
The *annual rainfall* in Keelung is higher than in most cities.
基隆的年降雨量比大多數城市都高。
We stayed home and played board games on *a rainy day*.
下雨天我們待在家裡玩桌遊。
*The rainy season* in Taiwan usually starts in May.
台灣的雨季通常從五月開始。
Please *raise your hand* if you know the answer.
如果你知道答案，請舉手。
Our class sold cookies to *raise money* for the animal shelter.
我們班賣餅乾為動物收容所募款。
My grandparents helped my parents *raise three children*.
我的祖父母幫我爸媽養大了三個孩子。
I bought a loaf of *raisin bread* for breakfast.
我買了一條葡萄乾麵包當早餐。
The students *held a rally* to protect the old trees on campus.
學生舉行集會，保護校園裡的老樹。
Everyone *rallied around* the family after the fire.
火災後，大家都團結起來幫助那一家人。
My cousin worked on a *cattle ranch* in Australia for a year.
我表哥在澳洲的牧牛場工作了一年。
Ten students were chosen *at random* to answer the survey.
十名學生被隨機選出填寫調查。
Police do *random checks* for drunk driving on weekends.
警方週末會隨機臨檢酒駕。

collocs.zh: 各式各樣的；範圍廣泛的
ex: The bookstore sells *a wide range of* study guides.
這家書店賣各式各樣的參考書。
The *age range* of the club members is twelve to fifteen.
社團成員的年齡範圍是十二到十五歲。
Ticket prices *range from 200 to 500* dollars.
票價從兩百元到五百元不等。
Our school *ranked first* in the city's English speech contest.
我們學校在市內英語演講比賽中排名第一。
This night market *ranks among* the most popular in Taiwan.
這個夜市名列台灣最受歡迎的夜市之一。
*Rap music* is very popular among teenagers in Taiwan.
饒舌音樂在台灣青少年之間非常受歡迎。
We heard *a rap on the door* late at night.
我們深夜聽到一陣敲門聲。
I had to *take the rap* for the broken window.
我只好為打破的窗戶背黑鍋。
The city has seen *rapid growth* in the past ten years.
這座城市在過去十年快速成長。
Phones have gone through *rapid changes* since I was born.
從我出生以來，手機經歷了快速的變化。
The black bear is *a rare animal* in Taiwan's mountains.
黑熊是台灣山區的稀有動物。
*It is rare to* see snow in Taipei.
在台北很少看到下雪。
The new soap gave my sister a *skin rash*.
新香皂讓我妹妹起了皮疹。
Don't make a *rash decision* when you are angry.
生氣時不要做輕率的決定。
There has been *a rash of* bike thefts near the station.
車站附近最近發生一連串腳踏車竊案。
My cousin was born in *the Year of the Rat*.
我表弟屬鼠。
Taiwan's *birth rate* is one of the lowest in the world.
台灣的出生率是全世界最低的之一。
The ice is melting *at a rate of* several meters a year.
冰層正以每年好幾公尺的速度融化。
Check the *exchange rate* before you change money for your trip.
旅行換錢前，先查一下匯率。
I *would rather* stay home than go to the mall.
我寧願待在家也不想去購物中心。
Let's walk to school *rather than* take the bus.
我們走路上學，而不是搭公車吧。
The math test was *rather difficult* this time.
這次的數學考試相當難。
The two countries finally *ratified the treaty* last year.
兩國去年終於批准了這項條約。
Lawmakers voted to *ratify the agreement* on trade.
立法委員投票批准這項貿易協議。
Small schools usually have a low *student-teacher ratio*.
小學校的師生比通常較低。
Mix the water and flour *in a ratio of* two to one.
以二比一的比例混合水和麵粉。
Try to stay calm and make a *rational decision* about your future.
試著保持冷靜，對未來做理性的決定。
There must be a *rational explanation* for the strange noise.
那奇怪的聲音一定有合理的解釋。
She can *rattle off* the names of all the MRT stations.
她能一口氣說出所有捷運站的名字。
The baby laughed when I shook the *baby rattle*.
我搖嬰兒搖鈴時，寶寶笑了。
Taiwan imports most of the *raw materials* its factories need.
台灣工廠所需的原料大部分都仰賴進口。
Our science group collected the *raw data* and made a chart.
我們自然課小組收集了原始資料並做成圖表。
The new medicine gave the patients *a ray of hope*.
這種新藥帶給病人一線希望。
*Rays of light* shone through the trees in the morning forest.
清晨的森林裡，光線穿過樹木灑落下來。
Be careful when you change the *razor blade*.
換刀片的時候要小心。
She studied every night to *reach her goal*.
她每天晚上讀書，為了達成目標。
He *reached for* his phone when it rang.
電話響時，他伸手去拿手機。
The two teams finally *reached an agreement*.
兩隊終於達成協議。
Plants *react to* light by growing toward it.
植物對光的反應是朝著光生長。
The driver *reacted quickly* and stopped just in time.
司機迅速反應，及時停了下來。
What was the students' *reaction to* the new phone rules?
學生們對新的手機規定有什麼反應？
Mixing vinegar and baking soda causes a *chemical reaction*.
醋和小蘇打混合會產生化學反應。
He had an *allergic reaction* after eating some shrimp.
他吃了一些蝦子後產生過敏反應。
I like to *read a book* before I go to bed.
我喜歡睡前看書。
The teacher asked me to *read the story aloud*.
老師要我把故事大聲唸出來。
I *read about* the typhoon on the news app.
我在新聞應用程式上讀到颱風的消息。
Are you *ready for* the English test tomorrow?
你準備好明天的英文考試了嗎？
Hurry up and *get ready* for school!
快點準備好去上學！
We *are ready to* leave for the MRT station.
我們準備好要出發去捷運站了。
Superheroes don't exist in *real life*.
現實生活中沒有超級英雄。
*A real friend* helps you when you are in trouble.
真正的朋友會在你有困難時幫助你。
The sound effects add *a sense of realism* to the game.
音效為遊戲增添了真實感。
You need to be *realistic about* how much you can study in a day.
你得務實看待自己一天能讀多少書。
Parents should have *realistic expectations* for their children.
父母對孩子應該有合理的期望。
The test looked easy, but *in reality* it was very hard.
這考試看起來很簡單，但實際上很難。
You have to *face reality* and study harder.
你必須面對現實，更用功讀書。
He *came to the realization* that money can't buy happiness.
他終於領悟到金錢買不到快樂。
She had a *sudden realization* that she had left her phone on the bus.
她突然意識到自己把手機忘在公車上了。
Opening the café was the *realization of a dream* for my aunt.
開這間咖啡廳是我阿姨夢想的實現。
He *realized his mistake* after he handed in the test.
他交卷後才發現自己的錯誤。
She worked hard to *realize her dream* of becoming a doctor.
她努力工作，實現成為醫生的夢想。
I *really like* the new teacher at my cram school.
我真的很喜歡補習班的新老師。
"Are you tired?" "*Not really*, I slept well."
「你累嗎？」「不太累，我睡得很好。」
Winning the contest is *within the realm of possibility* if we practice hard.
只要我們努力練習，贏得比賽是有可能的。
Students who exercise daily *reap the benefits* in their health.
每天運動的學生在健康上得到好處。
After years of practice, she finally *reaped the rewards*.
經過多年練習，她終於收穫成果。
You *reap what you sow*, so be kind to others.
種瓜得瓜，所以要善待別人。
The bathrooms are located *at the rear of* the restaurant.
洗手間在餐廳的後面。
The slowest hiker *brought up the rear* of the group.
走得最慢的登山客走在隊伍最後面。
What is *the reason for* your absence yesterday?
你昨天缺席的原因是什麼？
It was raining hard. *For this reason*, the game was canceled.
雨下得很大，因為這個原因，比賽取消了。
You need *a good reason* to miss class.
你需要一個好理由才能不來上課。
We found a hotel near the beach at a *reasonable price*.
我們在海邊找到一間價格合理的飯店。
Asking for more time to finish the project is a *reasonable request*.
要求更多時間完成專題是個合理的要求。
I *felt reassured* after talking to my teacher about the exam.
跟老師談過考試的事後，我安心多了。
Some teenagers *rebel against* their parents' rules.
有些青少年會反抗父母的規定。
The *rebel leader* gave a speech to his soldiers.
叛軍首領對他的士兵發表演說。
Dyeing his hair green was a small act of *teenage rebellion*.
把頭髮染成綠色是他小小的青春叛逆。
The story is about a *rebellion against* a cruel ruler.
這個故事講述對殘暴統治者的反抗。
*As I recall*, the test was on a Monday last year.
據我記得，去年的考試是在星期一。
The car company announced a *product recall* because of faulty brakes.
那家汽車公司因煞車有問題宣布召回產品。
Always *keep the receipt* when you buy something expensive.
買貴的東西時一定要保留收據。
Don't forget to *ask for a receipt* when you pay the fee.
繳費時別忘了索取收據。
I *received a letter* from my pen pal in Japan.
我收到日本筆友的來信。
She *received a gift* from her aunt on her birthday.
她生日時收到阿姨送的禮物。
Grandma *picked up the receiver* and said hello in Taiwanese.
奶奶拿起聽筒，用台語說了聲你好。
*In recent years*, more students have taken online classes.
近年來，越來越多學生上線上課程。
*A recent study* says teenagers need more sleep.
最近的一項研究說青少年需要更多睡眠。
The *wedding reception* was held at a hotel in Taichung.
婚宴在台中的一家飯店舉行。
The exchange students got a *warm reception* from our class.
交換學生受到我們班的熱烈歡迎。
There's *poor reception* in the mountains, so my calls kept dropping.
山上收訊不好，所以我的電話一直斷線。
The *economic recession* made it hard for graduates to find jobs.
經濟衰退讓畢業生很難找到工作。
Experts fear the country may soon be *in recession*.
專家擔心國家可能很快陷入衰退。
I *followed the recipe* carefully, but the cake still came out flat.
我很仔細地照著食譜做，但蛋糕還是沒發起來。
Studying all night before the exam is *a recipe for disaster*.
考試前整晚熬夜念書是注定會失敗的做法。
Hard work and good sleep are *a recipe for success* in senior high.
努力加上充足睡眠是高中生活成功的祕訣。
Each *scholarship recipient* must keep good grades every semester.
每位獎學金得主每學期都必須維持好成績。
Each student had to *recite a poem* in front of the class.
每位學生都要在全班面前背誦一首詩。
She could *recite from memory* every line of the play.
她能憑記憶背出劇中的每一句台詞。
*Reckless driving* causes many accidents on mountain roads.
魯莽駕駛在山路上造成許多事故。
His *reckless behavior* at the beach worried the lifeguard.
他在海邊的魯莽行為讓救生員很擔心。

collocs.c: a force to be reckoned with
ex: The new team is *a force to be reckoned with* this season.
這支新球隊是本季不可小覷的勁敵。
The club gave him a prize *in recognition of* his hard work.
社團頒獎給他，以表彰他的努力。
The young artist slowly *gained recognition* for her street paintings.
那位年輕藝術家的街頭畫作漸漸獲得認可。
Many phones now use *face recognition* instead of passwords.
現在很多手機用臉部辨識取代密碼。
More parents now *recognize the importance of* sleep for teens.
現在有更多家長認識到睡眠對青少年的重要性。
This English test is *internationally recognized* by many universities.
這項英文檢定受到許多大學的國際認可。
I *highly recommend* this book to anyone who loves science.
我強烈推薦這本書給喜愛科學的人。
Doctors *recommend that* teenagers sleep at least eight hours a night.
醫生建議青少年每晚至少睡八小時。
My English teacher wrote me a *letter of recommendation* for college.
英文老師幫我寫了一封申請大學的推薦信。
The committee will *make a recommendation* to the principal next week.
委員會下週將向校長提出建議。
He wanted to *reconcile with* his father before moving abroad.
他想在出國前與父親和解。
She *was reconciled to* the idea of retaking the exam.
她已接受要重考的事實。
He *broke the school record* for the 100-meter run.
他打破了學校的百米紀錄。
I *keep a record of* every new word I learn.
我把學到的每個新單字都記錄下來。
We *recorded a video* for our English project.
我們為英文報告錄了一部影片。
She used a *voice recorder* to tape the professor's lecture.
她用錄音筆把教授的課錄下來。
Most kids in Taiwan learn to *play the recorder* in elementary school.
台灣大部分的孩子在國小都學過吹直笛。
It took her two weeks to *recover from* the flu.
她花了兩週才從流感中康復。
My grandpa has *fully recovered* after the surgery.
我爺爺手術後已經完全康復了。
Doctors expect her to *make a full recovery* after the accident.
醫生預期她在車禍後能完全康復。
The news says *economic recovery* will be slow this year.
新聞說今年的經濟復甦會很緩慢。
After a week in bed, Grandpa is finally *on the road to recovery*.
在床上躺了一週後，爺爺終於逐漸康復了。
We play basketball at the *recreation center* every Saturday.
我們每週六在活動中心打籃球。
Hiking is the most popular form of *outdoor recreation* in Taiwan.
健行是台灣最受歡迎的戶外休閒活動。
The camp offers *recreational activities* like swimming and hiking.
營隊提供游泳和健行等休閒活動。
The new community center has excellent *recreational facilities*.
新的社區中心有很棒的休閒設施。
The dance club is trying to *recruit new members* this semester.
熱舞社這學期正在招募新社員。
Every *new recruit* gets two weeks of training.
每位新進人員都有兩週的訓練。
*Draw a rectangle* and write your name inside it.
畫一個長方形，並在裡面寫上你的名字。
Our school asks every class to *recycle plastic bottles*.
我們學校要求每班回收寶特瓶。
We *recycle paper* in the blue box in the classroom.
我們把紙類回收到教室裡的藍色箱子。
Her face *turned red* when everyone looked at her.
大家都看著她時，她的臉紅了。
Never cross the street at *a red light*.
紅燈時千萬不要過馬路。
The girl *dressed in red* is my cousin.
穿紅衣服的那個女孩是我的表妹。
Listening to music helps me *reduce stress* before exams.
聽音樂幫助我在考前減輕壓力。
Regular exercise can *reduce the risk of* heart disease.
規律運動可以降低罹患心臟病的風險。
The school cafeteria is trying to *reduce waste* by using real plates.
學校餐廳改用可重複使用的餐盤來減少垃圾。
Scientists hope to see *a reduction in* plastic waste by 2030.
科學家希望在2030年前看到塑膠垃圾減少。
The store announced a *price reduction* on all winter jackets.
那家店宣布所有冬季外套降價。
These headphones have *noise reduction*, so I can study on the MRT.
這副耳機有降噪功能，所以我可以在捷運上念書。
Good writers *avoid redundancy* and keep their sentences short.
好的作者會避免冗贅，讓句子簡短。
Warmer seas are killing many *coral reefs* around the world.
海水變暖正使世界各地許多珊瑚礁死亡。
We watched a video about the *Great Barrier Reef* in science class.

大雨過後，在濕滑的路面上要開慢一點。

ex: Cheating on one quiz can be a *slippery slope* to bigger problems.

好的廣告標語簡短又好記。

群眾在市政府前喊口號。

公車在雨中爬那段陡坡很吃力。

那座茶園位在一片面海的緩坡上。

我們在日本的滑雪坡道上待了一整天。

經理不會接受我們任何人交出草率的工作。

經濟衰退期間，許多年輕人丟了工作。

公司把銷量暴跌歸咎於多雨的夏天。

練習結束後，他癱坐在椅子上閉上眼睛。

我弟弟吃了我的蛋糕後，對我露出狡黠的笑容。

他該讀書的時候卻在偷偷打電動。

只有少數學生通過考試。
We made *small talk* while waiting for the bus.
我們等公車時閒聊了幾句。
Taking the MRT is *a smart idea* during rush hour.
尖峰時間搭捷運是個聰明的主意。
She was *smart enough* to bring an umbrella.
她很聰明，有帶雨傘。

這部低成本電影在亞洲大受歡迎。

這名跑者打破了四百公尺賽跑的紀錄。

這炸雞聞起來好香！
Dogs have a strong *sense of smell*.
狗的嗅覺很靈敏。

我喜歡剛出爐麵包的香味。

新同學對我微笑。

她面帶微笑回答問題。

濃厚的霧霾籠罩城市，所以我們整天待在室內。
My uncle *stopped smoking* last year.
我叔叔去年戒菸了。

門上有一個「禁止吸菸」的標誌。
Babies usually have very *smooth skin*.
嬰兒的皮膚通常非常光滑。

她把校服上的皺摺撫平。

兩名男子因走私毒品在機場被捕。

我通常在晚上補習前先吃點心。

對不起我剛才對你兇，我只是真的很累。

魔術師一彈手指，硬幣就不見了。

他喜歡在社團聚會後和同學交流。

蔬菜在肥沃的土壤中長得很好。

Call *technical support* if the software doesn't work.
如果軟體無法運作，請打電話給技術支援。

這份工作需要很強的技術能力和良好的團隊合作。
