實驗室技術員為我們的化學課準備好一切。
A simple *breathing technique* can help you stay calm before an exam.
簡單的呼吸技巧可以幫助你在考試前保持冷靜。
Our English teacher tries new *teaching techniques* every semester.
我們的英文老師每學期都嘗試新的教學技巧。
*Technological advances* have changed the way we shop.
科技進步改變了我們購物的方式。
Taiwan plays a big role in global *technological development*.
台灣在全球科技發展中扮演重要角色。
*Modern technology* makes learning English much easier.
現代科技讓學英文變得容易許多。
My cousin studies *information technology* in college.
我表哥在大學念資訊科技。
Checking every answer by hand was a *tedious task*.
一題一題手動檢查答案是件乏味的工作。
The speech was so *long and tedious* that many people fell asleep.
那場演講又長又無聊，很多人都睡著了。
My mom says her *teenage years* were the happiest time of her life.
我媽說她的青少年時期是她人生中最快樂的時光。

數百名青少年粉絲在飯店外等候那個樂團。

我爸爸青少年時期很愛打籃球。

一群青少年在公園裡跳舞。

我媽媽十幾歲就開始工作了。

許多孩子在十三四歲時拿到第一支手機。

隨著智慧型手機興起，電信業快速改變。

在十九世紀，重要的消息常用電報傳送。
My sister is always *on the phone* with her friends.
我姐姐總是在跟朋友講電話。
Can you *answer the phone*? I'm in the shower.
你可以接一下電話嗎？我在洗澡。
Can I have your *phone number*?
我可以要你的電話號碼嗎？
I need to *make a phone call* to my mom.
我需要打個電話給媽媽。
Why didn't you *pick up the phone* last night?
你昨晚為什麼不接電話？
You can see Saturn's rings *through a telescope*.
透過望遠鏡可以看到土星環。
The *space telescope* sent back amazing pictures of distant stars.
太空望遠鏡傳回遙遠星星的驚人影像。
I *watch TV* for an hour after dinner.
我晚餐後看一個小時的電視。
There is a basketball game *on TV* tonight.
今晚電視上有籃球比賽。
Can you *turn on the TV*? The news is on.
你可以打開電視嗎？新聞開始了。

你現在最喜歡的電視節目是什麼？

請說實話，窗戶是怎麼破的。

我分不出這對雙胞胎誰是誰。

她在火車站附近的分行當銀行出納員。

我阿姨選婚期之前去找了算命師。

我們又遲到時，教練發脾氣了。

我叔叔脾氣不好，很容易生氣。

護理師會先幫你量體溫。

預計這個週末會出現高溫。

我發燒了，所以今天待在家。

這首舞曲節奏很快，讓人想跟著動起來。

暑假期間，我在一家書店找到一份臨時工作。

collocs.zh: 權宜之計；暫時的解決辦法

在破窗上貼膠帶只是暫時的解決辦法。
I *was tempted to* skip class and sleep in.
我很想翹課睡懶覺。

騎機車不戴安全帽真的是在玩命。
I *resisted the temptation* to check my messages during the test.
考試時我忍住了查看訊息的誘惑。
She *gave in to temptation* and ate the whole cake.
她經不起誘惑，把整個蛋糕吃掉了。
My score was in the *top ten* in my class.
我的成績是班上前十名。
The contract protects both the *landlord and tenant*.
這份合約同時保障房東與房客。

過年前物價往往會上漲。
Grandpa *tends the garden* every morning before breakfast.
爺爺每天早餐前都會照料花園。

我緊張時往往會講太快。
There is *a growing tendency* for young people to live alone.
年輕人獨居的趨勢日益增加。
She started playing the piano *at the tender age of* four.
她小小年紀四歲就開始彈鋼琴。
The sick puppy needs some *tender loving care*.
那隻生病的小狗需要細心的呵護。
My parents *play tennis* every weekend.
我爸媽每個週末打網球。

我們學校後面有一座網球場。
There was a *tense atmosphere* in the room before the final game.
決賽前室內氣氛很緊張。
My shoulders always *tense up* when I sit at a computer too long.
我坐在電腦前太久，肩膀總會緊繃起來。
The teacher told a joke to *ease the tension*.
老師講了個笑話來緩和緊張的氣氛。
There is some *tension between* the two clubs over the gym schedule.
兩個社團之間因為體育館的時間表而關係緊張。
It took us an hour to *put up the tent*.
我們花了一個小時搭帳篷。
We *slept in a tent* by the river.
我們睡在河邊的帳篷裡。
Our *tentative plan* is to visit Tainan during winter break.
我們暫定的計畫是寒假去台南。
The two companies reached a *tentative agreement* last night.
兩家公司昨晚達成初步協議。
We have five exams *this term*.
我們這學期有五次考試。
*In terms of* price, this phone is a good choice.
就價格而言，這支手機是不錯的選擇。
Meet me at the *bus terminal* at seven o'clock.
七點在公車總站跟我碰面。
The hospital takes care of patients with *terminal illnesses*.
這家醫院照顧罹患末期疾病的病人。
The *rice terraces* in the mountains turn green in spring.
春天時，山上的梯田一片翠綠。
The café has a *rooftop terrace* where you can watch the sunset.
這間咖啡館有個可以看夕陽的屋頂露台。
I made *a terrible mistake* and deleted my report.
我犯了一個大錯，把報告刪掉了。
I *feel terrible* about forgetting your birthday.
忘了你的生日，我覺得很過意不去。
We stayed in because of the *terrible weather*.
因為天氣很糟，我們待在室內。
You *did a terrific job* on your speech.
你的演講表現得很棒。
A trip to the beach *sounds terrific*!
去海邊玩聽起來太棒了！
My little brother *is terrified of* spiders and cockroaches.
我弟弟非常怕蜘蛛和蟑螂。
He had a *terrified look* on his face after the ride.
坐完那個遊樂設施後，他一臉驚恐。
The pilot was shot down over *enemy territory*.
那名飛行員在敵方領土上空被擊落。
Starting college in a new city was *unfamiliar territory* for me.
到一個新城市讀大學對我來說是全新的領域。
People ran *in terror* when the building started shaking.
大樓開始搖晃時，人們驚恐地逃跑。
The city increased security after the *terror attack*.
恐怖攻擊後，這座城市加強了維安。
Many countries work together to *fight terrorism*.
許多國家合作打擊恐怖主義。
The news called the bombing *an act of terrorism*.
新聞把這起爆炸事件稱為恐怖行動。
The airport is very careful to stop *a terrorist attack*.
機場非常小心防範恐怖攻擊。
The police found members of *a terrorist group*.
警方找到了一個恐怖組織的成員。
We will *take a test* on Unit 3 next week.
我們下星期要考第三課。
I studied hard and *passed the test*.
我努力讀書，通過了考試。
I got a high score on *the math test*.
我數學考試考得很高分。
She was afraid to *testify against* her former boss.
她害怕出庭指證她的前老闆。
His many awards *testify to* his hard work.
他得到的許多獎項證明了他的努力。
I'll *send a text* to my mom after school.
我放學後會傳簡訊給媽媽。
Please *read the text* on page twenty.
請讀第二十頁的課文。
I left my *English textbook* at school.
我把英文課本忘在學校了。
*Open your textbooks* to page forty-five.
把課本翻到第四十五頁。
The *textile industry* was very important to Taiwan's economy in the past.
紡織業過去對台灣經濟非常重要。
My grandmother worked in a *textile factory* when she was young.
我奶奶年輕時在紡織廠工作。

collocs.zh: 光滑的質地；滑順的口感
ex: This egg pudding from the bakery has a very *smooth texture*.
這家麵包店的雞蛋布丁口感非常滑順。
The wall has a *rough texture* that feels like sand.
這面牆的質地粗糙，摸起來像沙子。

超過三十位學生加入了這個社團。

我寧願走路，而不是搭公車。

我想謝謝你的幫忙。

謝天謝地，颱風沒有直撲我們。
I *am thankful for* all the help my teachers gave me this year.
我很感謝老師們今年給我的所有幫助。

那家人很感謝救了他們房子的消防員。

我錯過了公車，所以才遲到。

我們吃了晚餐，之後看了一部電影。

我的手機跟你的一樣。

你練習得越多，就會越有自信。

永遠不要在網路上透露身分證字號，以免身分被盜用。

自從裝了更多監視器後，汽車竊盜案就減少了。

我們在東京的主題樂園玩了一整天。
Everyone in class can sing the drama's *theme song*.
全班都會唱那部劇的主題曲。
The *main theme* of the novel is friendship.
這本小說的中心思想是友誼。
I moved here in 2020 and have lived here *since then*.
我二〇二〇年搬來，從那時起就一直住在這裡。
The party starts at eight. I'll be there *by then*.
派對八點開始，我到時候會到。
I was about to answer. *Just then*, the bell rang.
我正要回答，就在那時鐘聲響了。
He went abroad to *study theology* at a famous university.
他出國到一所知名大學研讀神學。
*Theoretical knowledge* is not enough; you also need practice.
光有理論知識不夠，還需要實際練習。
She wants to study *theoretical physics* in college.
她想在大學讀理論物理學。
*In theory*, the plan sounds great, but it costs too much.
理論上這個計畫聽起來很棒，但花費太高了。
We learned about the *theory of evolution* in biology class.
我們在生物課上學了演化論。
The *physical therapist* helped me walk again after surgery.
物理治療師幫助我在手術後重新走路。

語言治療師協助說話有困難的孩子。

踢足球受傷後，她的膝蓋需要做物理治療。
He *underwent therapy* to deal with his fear of flying.
他接受治療來克服對搭飛機的恐懼。

我學校附近有一間便利商店。
The bus stop is *over there*.
公車站在那邊。
The fire started at noon, and the firefighters arrived *shortly thereafter*.
火災在中午發生，不久之後消防員就到了。
*The thermometer reads* thirty-six degrees, so it's a very hot day.
溫度計顯示三十六度，今天非常熱。
*These days*, many students study with their phones.
最近很多學生用手機讀書。
He spent a whole year *writing a thesis* on Taiwanese music.
他花了整整一年寫一篇關於台灣音樂的論文。
Every essay should start with a clear *thesis statement*.
每篇文章都應該以清楚的主旨句開頭。
The kids made dinner *by themselves*.
孩子們自己做了晚餐。
The students finished the project *on their own*.
學生們靠自己完成了這份報告。
This dictionary is *a thick book*.
這本字典很厚。
*Thick fog* covered the mountain road this morning.
今天早上濃霧籠罩了山路。
The police *caught the thief* near the night market.
警察在夜市附近抓到了小偷。
The bento comes with a grilled *chicken thigh*.
這個便當附一塊烤雞腿肉。

每天做深蹲能讓你的大腿肌肉更強壯。
She cut the cake into *thin slices*.
她把蛋糕切成薄片。
The doctor said I'm *too thin* and should eat more.
醫生說我太瘦了，應該多吃一點。
We were thinking *the same thing*!
我們剛好想到同一件事！
*The first thing* I do every morning is drink water.
我每天早上做的第一件事就是喝水。
I like drawing, singing, and *things like that*.
我喜歡畫畫、唱歌之類的事。
I need to *think about* which club to join.
我需要想想要加入哪個社團。
Can you *think of* a good name for our team?
你想得出我們隊伍的好名字嗎？

在網路上發文之前要三思。
*One third of* the students take the bus to school.
三分之一的學生搭公車上學。
Our class won *third place* in the singing contest.
我們班在歌唱比賽得到第三名。

比賽後沒有什麼比冰水更能解渴了。
Her *thirst for knowledge* led her to read every book in the library.
她的求知慾讓她讀遍了圖書館裡的每一本書。

體育課跑完步後我總是覺得口渴。

帶水去，爬山時你會口渴。

我弟弟十三歲。

雖然我感冒了，我還是去上學。

她在畢業那天送老師一份貼心的禮物。

他能記得每個人的生日，真是體貼。

每天有成千上萬的人來逛夜市。

這件外套要一千元。

你有針線嗎？我的襯衫破了。

爺爺眼睛不好，所以叫我幫他穿針。

我演講時太緊張，結果講到忘了接下來要說什麼。
Plastic waste *poses a threat to* sea turtles.
塑膠垃圾對海龜構成威脅。
Many old buildings in the city are *under threat* from new development.
城裡許多老建築受到新開發案的威脅。
Dark clouds *threatened to* ruin our school sports day.
烏雲密布，校運會眼看就要泡湯了。
The Formosan black bear *is threatened with extinction*.
台灣黑熊正面臨絕種的威脅。
I go swimming *three times a week*.
我一週游泳三次。

剛畢業的年輕人正站在新生活的起點。

我弟弟很能忍痛，從來不哭。
My uncle loves *the thrill of* jumping out of a plane.
我叔叔熱愛從飛機上跳下去的刺激感。

聽到我們隊贏了，我們都興奮極了。

那部新的心理驚悚片讓我一直猜到最後。
My dad enjoys reading *crime thrillers* on the train.
我爸爸喜歡在火車上看犯罪驚悚小說。

collocs.zh: 在……中如魚得水；因……而成長
ex: Some students *thrive on* pressure and do their best work before exams.
有些學生在壓力下反而表現更好，考前做得最出色。
Some children *thrive in* small classes with lots of attention.
有些孩子在受到充分關注的小班裡成長得特別好。
Drink warm water if you have *a sore throat*.
喉嚨痛的話就喝溫水。
The teacher *cleared her throat* and began to speak.
老師清了清喉嚨，開始說話。
She *came to the throne* at the age of twenty-five.
她二十五歲時登基。
The prince is the *heir to the throne*.
這位王子是王位繼承人。
We *went through* a tunnel on the way to Yilan.
我們去宜蘭的路上經過一條隧道。
The sun came in *through the window*.
陽光從窗戶照進來。
It rained *all through* the night.
雨下了一整夜。
Taiwan has fruit to eat *throughout the year*.
台灣一年四季都有水果可以吃。

一整天都要記得喝水。

先別把舊筆記丟掉。

你可以把球丟給我嗎？

不要朝同學丟紙。

這場演講的重點是節約能源。

影片爆紅後，她突然成為眾人注目的焦點。

比賽後教練對我們豎起大拇指。
My baby sister still *sucks her thumb*.
我的小妹妹還在吸大拇指。
There was *thunder and lightning* all night.
整晚都雷電交加。

學生會為畢業舉辦了一場音樂會。
This fruit *is unique to* Taiwan.
這種水果是台灣特有的。
This trip is *a unique chance* to learn about Japan.
這趟旅行是認識日本的難得機會。
We will have a test on *Unit 1* tomorrow.
我們明天要考第一單元。
A meter is *a unit of* length.
公尺是長度的單位。
Neighbors *united against* the plan to build a factory nearby.
鄰居們團結起來反對在附近蓋工廠的計畫。
Our class must *unite as one* to win the chorus contest.
我們班必須團結一心才能贏得合唱比賽。
Team sports give students a strong *sense of unity*.
團隊運動讓學生有很強的團結感。
The president's speech called for *national unity* after the disaster.
總統在災後的演說中呼籲全國團結。
Some people say a smile is a *universal language*.
有人說微笑是一種共通語言。
Taiwan is known for its *universal health care* system.
台灣以全民健保制度聞名。
Are we alone *in the universe*?
我們是宇宙中唯一的生命嗎？
My sister wants to *go to university* in Taipei.
我姊姊想去台北讀大學。
My cousin is a *university student*.
我表哥是大學生。
You won't pass *unless you* study harder.
除非你更用功，否則不會及格。
Dad came home late and quietly *unlocked the door*.
爸爸很晚回家，輕輕打開了門鎖。
Scientists hope to *unlock the secret* of a longer life.
科學家希望揭開長壽的祕密。
Good teachers help students *unlock their potential* in many different ways.
好老師用各種方式幫助學生發揮潛能。
Housing prices in the city have risen to an *unprecedented level*.
這座城市的房價已上漲到前所未有的程度。
Hospitals faced an *unprecedented challenge* during the pandemic.
疫情期間醫院面臨前所未有的挑戰。
*Wait until* the light turns green.
等到燈變綠。
I *didn't go to bed until* midnight.
我直到半夜才睡覺。
*Until now*, I have never been to Japan.
直到現在，我從來沒去過日本。
The mayor *unveiled a plan* to build more bike lanes.
市長公布了一項增建自行車道的計畫。
The town *unveiled a statue* of its most famous writer.
鎮上為最有名的作家雕像揭幕。
I *get up* at six thirty on school days.
上學日我六點半起床。
My dad *picks me up* after cram school.
我爸爸在補習班下課後來接我。
She ran *up the stairs* to her room.
她跑上樓梯回到她的房間。
My laptop needs a *software update* before I can use it.
我的筆電需要先做軟體更新才能使用。

collocs.zh: 隨時告知某人最新情況
ex: Please *keep me updated* on your trip by sending photos.
旅行期間請傳照片，隨時讓我知道你的最新情況。
The airline *upgraded us to* business class for free.
航空公司免費把我們升等到商務艙。
The school website is down for a *system upgrade*.
學校網站因系統升級暫停服務。
I *uploaded a photo* of our class trip.
我上傳了一張我們班出遊的照片。
Please *upload your homework to* the class website.
請把作業上傳到班級網站。
*Once upon a time*, there lived a little girl.
從前從前，住著一個小女孩。
Our plans *depend upon* the weather.
我們的計畫要看天氣決定。
Our classroom is on the *upper floor*.
我們的教室在樓上。
Push-ups make your *upper body* strong.
伏地挺身能讓你的上半身變強壯。
My grandmother always *sits upright* at the dinner table.
我奶奶在餐桌前總是坐得挺直。
Please return your seat to the *upright position* before landing.
降落前請將椅背豎直。
He was known as an honest and *upright citizen* in the town.
他在鎮上以誠實正直著稱。
The government quickly ended the *armed uprising* in the north.
政府迅速平息了北部的武裝起義。
A *popular uprising* forced the king to leave the country.
一場民眾起義迫使國王離開國家。
She *was upset about* her test score.
她為考試成績感到難過。
I have an *upset stomach* after eating too much.
我吃太多，胃不舒服。
Don't *get upset*. It's only a game.
別生氣，只是個遊戲而已。
*Go upstairs* and do your homework.
上樓去寫功課。
Our *upstairs neighbor* has a noisy dog.
我們樓上的鄰居養了一隻很吵的狗。
The number of foreign tourists shows an *upward trend* this year.
今年外國觀光客人數呈現上升趨勢。
Education is a key path to *upward mobility* for many families.
教育是許多家庭向上流動的關鍵途徑。
The arrow on the sign *points upward*, so the exit is upstairs.
標示上的箭頭指向上方，所以出口在樓上。
We *looked upward* and saw an eagle flying above us.
我們往上看，看到一隻老鷹在頭頂飛。
More and more young people are moving to *urban areas*.
越來越多的年輕人搬到都市地區。
My cousin studies *urban planning* at a university in Taichung.
我表哥在台中的一所大學念都市計畫。
After the exam, I *had an urge to* sleep all day.
考完試後，我很想睡一整天。
Teachers *urge students to get* enough sleep before the test.
老師們力勸學生考試前要睡飽。
The news about climate change gave us a *sense of urgency*.
氣候變遷的新聞讓我們有了急迫感。
Fixing the broken bridge is *a matter of urgency*.
修好那座壞掉的橋是當務之急。
There is an *urgent need* for blood donors after the accident.
事故過後急需捐血者。
The old school building is *in urgent need of* repair.
那棟老舊的校舍急需整修。
The city asked people to cut their *water usage* during the dry season.
市政府要求民眾在乾季減少用水量。
Pay attention to *word usage* when you write your essay.
寫作文時要注意字詞的用法。
I *use my phone to* look up new words.
我用手機查新單字。
*Make use of* your free time to read.
利用空閒時間閱讀。
*It's no use crying* about it now.
現在哭也沒用了。
My uncle bought a *used car*.
我叔叔買了一輛二手車。
You can buy *used books* online for less money.
你可以在網路上買比較便宜的二手書。
This app *is useful for* learning English.
這個 app 對學英文很有用。
The website has a lot of *useful information*.
這個網站有很多有用的資料。
Type your *user name* and password.
輸入你的使用者名稱和密碼。
Most *phone users* check messages many times a day.
大部分手機用戶一天會看很多次訊息。
The smartphone *ushered in* a new age of communication.
智慧型手機開創了通訊的新時代。
We were *ushered into* the meeting room by a secretary.
一位秘書把我們領進會議室。
*As usual*, he was late for class.
他跟往常一樣上課遲到。
I got up earlier *than usual* today.
我今天比平常早起。
The shop sells all kinds of *kitchen utensils*, from knives to pans.
那家店賣各種廚房用具，從刀子到鍋子都有。
Many students now carry their own *eating utensils* to school.
現在許多學生自己帶餐具到學校。
Our *utility bill* is higher in summer because of the air conditioner.
夏天因為開冷氣，我們的水電費比較高。
Water and electricity are provided by *public utility* companies.
水和電是由公用事業公司提供的。
We should *utilize resources* like the library more often.
我們應該更常利用圖書館之類的資源。
Students should *fully utilize* their free time to review.
學生應該充分利用空閒時間來複習。
What he said about the test being canceled is *utter nonsense*.
他說考試取消的話根本是胡說八道。
She sat there for an hour and didn't *utter a word*.
她在那裡坐了一個小時，一句話也沒說。
The school is looking for a teacher to *fill the vacancy*.
學校正在找一位老師來填補空缺。
The café posted a *job vacancy* on its website.
那家咖啡店在網站上公布了職缺。
There are no *vacant seats* on the MRT during rush hour.
尖峰時段的捷運上沒有空位。
Kids play baseball on the *vacant lot* behind the temple.
孩子們在廟後面的空地上打棒球。
What did you do during *summer vacation*?
你暑假做了什麼？
My family is *on vacation* in Japan.
我們全家在日本度假。
We *went on vacation* to Penghu.
我們去澎湖度假。
The school offers a free *flu vaccine* to all students every fall.
學校每年秋天為所有學生提供免費的流感疫苗。
Scientists worked quickly to *develop a vaccine* for the new virus.
科學家迅速研發新病毒的疫苗。
Our new *vacuum cleaner* is quiet and light.
我們的新吸塵器又安靜又輕巧。
It's my job to *vacuum the floor* every weekend.
每個週末用吸塵器吸地板是我的工作。
Schools don't exist *in a vacuum*; they reflect society.
學校並不是孤立存在的，而是反映了社會。
I have only a *vague idea* of what I want to study.
我對自己想讀什麼只有模糊的概念。
He gave a *vague answer* when I asked where he had been.
我問他去了哪裡，他回答得很含糊。
We searched for the lost key *in vain*.
我們找那把弄丟的鑰匙，結果白費力氣。
In *a vain attempt* to stay awake, he drank three cups of coffee.
他喝了三杯咖啡想保持清醒，卻是白費力氣。
She made a *valid point* about the school's dress code.
她對學校服裝規定提出了一個有道理的看法。
You need a *valid passport* to travel abroad.
出國旅行需要有效的護照。
This coupon is *valid for* one month only.
這張優惠券只有一個月有效。
There is a river at the bottom of *a deep valley*.
深谷的底部有一條河。
Losing the game taught us a *valuable lesson*.
輸掉比賽讓我們學到寶貴的一課。
Don't leave *valuable things* in the classroom.
不要把貴重物品留在教室。
Grandpa taught me *the value of* hard work.
爺爺教我努力的價值。
I really *value friendship* more than grades.
比起成績，我更重視友誼。
This lunch box is *good value* for the price.
這個便當以這個價錢來說很划算。
A *delivery van* brings fresh bread to the shop every morning.
每天早上都有一輛送貨車把新鮮麵包送到店裡。
We had warm apple pie with *vanilla ice cream* for dessert.
我們的甜點是熱蘋果派配香草冰淇淋。
My keys seem to have *vanished into thin air*.
我的鑰匙好像憑空消失了。
The old ship *vanished without a trace* in the storm.
那艘老船在暴風雨中消失得無影無蹤。
She posts photos of every meal *out of vanity*.
她出於虛榮心，每餐都拍照上傳。
Clouds form when *water vapor* in the air cools down.
空氣中的水蒸氣冷卻時就會形成雲。
Sleep is a *key variable* in how well students learn.
睡眠是影響學生學習成效的關鍵變數。
The weather in the mountains is *highly variable*.
山上的天氣變化很大。
There is little *variation in* temperature in this area.
這個地區的溫度變化很小。
This dish is *a variation on* the classic beef noodle soup.
這道菜是經典牛肉麵的變化版。
There is *regional variation* in how people speak Taiwanese.
人們講台語的方式有地區差異。
The night market offers *a variety of* snacks and drinks.
夜市提供各式各樣的小吃和飲料。
People learn English *for a variety of reasons*.
人們出於種種原因學習英文。
The museum has *various kinds of* old cameras on display.
博物館展出了各種各樣的老相機。
Volunteers helped the flood victims *in various ways*.
志工們以各種方式幫助水災災民。
Prices *vary from shop to shop*, so compare before you buy.
價格因店而異，所以買之前先比較一下。
The apples in the box *vary in* size and color.
箱子裡的蘋果大小和顏色都不一樣。
Opinions about the new school rule *vary greatly*.
大家對新校規的看法差異很大。
There is always *a vase of flowers* at the hotel's front desk.
飯店櫃檯上總是擺著一瓶花。
*The vast majority* of students take the bus to school.
絕大多數的學生搭公車上學。
The internet gives us *a vast amount of* information.
網路提供我們大量的資訊。
Mom says I should *eat vegetables* every day.
媽媽說我每天都要吃蔬菜。
We buy *fresh vegetables* at the market.
我們在市場買新鮮蔬菜。
There are many good *vegetarian restaurants* in Taiwan.
台灣有很多好吃的素食餐廳。
As a *strict vegetarian*, she doesn't eat eggs or milk.
身為嚴格的素食者，她不吃蛋也不喝牛奶。
More people are buying *electric vehicles* to save on gas.
越來越多人買電動車來省油錢。
You need a license to drive any *motor vehicle* in Taiwan.
在台灣駕駛任何機動車輛都需要駕照。
*A veil of* fog covered the mountain this morning.
今天早上一層薄霧籠罩著山頭。
His comment was a *thinly veiled* attack on his classmate.
他的評論是對同學幾乎不加掩飾的攻擊。
His second book is written *in the same vein* as his first.
他的第二本書和第一本是同樣的風格。
She wore a black *velvet dress* to the year-end party.
她穿著黑色天鵝絨洋裝去參加尾牙。
I bought a sausage from a *street vendor*.
我跟路邊攤販買了一根香腸。
There are many *food vendors* at the night market.
夜市有很多小吃攤。
The two companies formed a *joint venture* to build electric cars.
兩家公司成立合資企業來生產電動車。
His first *business venture* failed, but he learned a lot.
他第一次創業失敗了，但學到了很多。
Very few people *ventured out* during the typhoon last night.
昨晚颱風期間很少有人敢出門。
The new *concert venue* can hold ten thousand people.
新的演唱會場地可以容納一萬人。
Because of the rain, there was a *change of venue*.
因為下雨，所以更換了場地。
We only had a *verbal agreement*, nothing in writing.
我們只有口頭協議，沒有任何書面文件。
*Verbal abuse* can hurt as much as physical violence.
言語暴力造成的傷害可能和肢體暴力一樣大。
Joining the debate club improved her *verbal skills*.
參加辯論社提升了她的語言表達能力。
The court took three days to *reach a verdict*.
法院花了三天才做出裁決。
The man's family cried after the *guilty verdict*.
那名男子的家人在有罪判決後哭了。
As a *versatile player*, he can play almost any position on the team.
身為全能選手，他幾乎能打隊上任何位置。
Bamboo is a *versatile material* used for houses, tools and food.
竹子是用途廣泛的材料，可用來蓋房子、做工具和當食物。
This old story was written *in verse*, not in plain prose.
這個古老的故事是用詩體寫的，而不是一般散文。
Download the *latest version* of the app before class.
上課前先下載這個應用程式的最新版本。
Is there an *English version* of this menu?
這份菜單有英文版嗎？
Each student told a different *version of events*.
每個學生對事情經過的說法都不一樣。
The chart shows each year as a *vertical line*.
這張圖表用一條垂直線代表每一年。
Most people watch *vertical video* on their phones.
大多數人用手機看直式影片。
Thank you *very much* for your help.
非常謝謝你的幫忙。
We wish you *the very best* in the new school.
祝你在新學校一切順利。
Smoking and too much salt can damage your *blood vessels*.
抽菸和吃太鹹都會傷害你的血管。
The *fishing vessel* returned to port before the typhoon.
那艘漁船在颱風來之前回港了。
Put on *a life vest* before you get in the boat.
上船前要穿上救生衣。
The *war veteran* told students about his life as a soldier.
那位退伍老兵向學生講述他當兵的生活。
The young team learned a lot from the *veteran player*.
這支年輕球隊從那位老將身上學到很多。
My cat hates being *taken to the vet* in her little box.
我的貓很討厭被裝在小籠子裡帶去看獸醫。
Five countries have *veto power* in the UN Security Council.
有五個國家在聯合國安理會擁有否決權。
The governor decided to *veto the bill* after the protests.
抗議過後，州長決定否決那項法案。
Please send your homework to me *via email*.
請用電子郵件把作業寄給我。
More students now take classes *via the Internet*.
現在有越來越多學生透過網路上課。
Studying abroad is not a *viable option* for every family.
出國留學並不是每個家庭都可行的選擇。
The plan is good, but is it *economically viable*?
這個計畫很好，但在經濟上可行嗎？
My *phone vibrates* every time I get a new message.
每次收到新訊息，我的手機就會震動。
People in Hualien *felt vibrations* from the earthquake for a full minute.
花蓮的民眾感覺到地震搖晃了整整一分鐘。
The *vice president* gave a speech at the opening ceremony.
副總統在開幕典禮上致詞。
The old story teaches children the difference between *virtue and vice*.
這個古老的故事教孩子分辨美德與惡行。
Stress and poor sleep can become a *vicious cycle*.
壓力和睡不好可能形成惡性循環。

collocs.zh: 惡毒的攻擊；兇殘的攻擊
ex: The singer faced a *vicious attack* on social media.
那位歌手在社群媒體上遭受惡毒的攻擊。
Many older people *fall victim to* phone scams every year.
每年都有許多長者成為電話詐騙的受害者。
The children were *innocent victims* of the war.
那些孩子是戰爭中無辜的受害者。
After three rounds, she *emerged as the victor* of the speech contest.
經過三輪比賽，她成為演講比賽的贏家。
Our team *won a victory* in the final game.
我們隊伍在決賽中獲勝。
We celebrated our *victory over* the other class.
我們慶祝打敗了另一班。
We *watched a video* about sea turtles in class.
我們上課看了一部關於海龜的影片。
Let's *make a video* for our group project.
我們為小組報告拍一支影片吧。
My brother plays *video games* every weekend.
我弟弟每個週末都打電玩。
My room has *a view of* the mountains.
我的房間可以看到山景。
Try to see it from my *point of view*.
試著從我的觀點來看。
*In my view*, homework should be shorter.
在我看來，功課應該少一點。
The show is popular with young *TV viewers*.
這個節目很受年輕電視觀眾歡迎。
Short and funny videos *attract viewers* much faster than long ones.
短又好笑的影片比長影片更能快速吸引觀眾。
*From the viewpoint of* a doctor, sleep is very important.
從醫生的觀點來看，睡眠非常重要。
Reading the news helps you understand *different viewpoints*.
閱讀新聞能幫助你理解不同的觀點。
The students cleaned the classroom *with vigor* before the holiday.
放假前，學生們賣力地打掃教室。
After a short rest, the team played with *renewed vigor*.
稍作休息後，球隊重新充滿活力地比賽。
Avoid *vigorous exercise* right after a big meal.
飽餐後要避免劇烈運動。
The new school rule led to a *vigorous debate* among students.
新的校規在學生之間引起激烈的辯論。
They stayed in a *holiday villa* by the sea for a week.
他們在海邊的度假別墅住了一週。
My grandpa grew up in *a small village*.
我爺爺在一個小村莊長大。
We had fresh seafood in a *fishing village*.
我們在一個漁村吃了新鮮的海鮮。
The actor usually *plays the villain* in TV dramas.
那位演員在電視劇裡通常演反派。
Every good story needs a strong *hero and villain*.
每個好故事都需要強大的英雄和反派。
The old wall behind our school is *covered in vines*.
我們學校後面的那面老牆爬滿了藤蔓。
I like to add *black vinegar* to my noodles.
我喜歡在麵裡加烏醋。
Companies that *violate the law* will have to pay a fine.
違法的公司將被罰款。
The report says the factory *violated human rights*.
報告指出那間工廠侵犯人權。
Posting someone's photo without asking can *violate their privacy*.
未經同意就張貼別人的照片可能侵犯他們的隱私。
The shop was *in violation of* safety rules.
那家店違反了安全規定。

我們去動物園看貓熊。
The *zookeeper* feeds the animals every morning.
動物園管理員每天早上餵動物。
You can *zoom in* on the map to see the street names.
你可以把地圖放大，看清楚街道名稱。
*Zoom out* a little so we can see the whole building.
把鏡頭拉遠一點，讓我們看到整棟建築。
He bought a *zoom lens* to take photos of birds.
他買了一顆變焦鏡頭來拍鳥。
My cousin is working *in China* now.
我表哥現在在中國工作。
This phone case was *made in China*.
這個手機殼是中國製造的。
The school sports day is *in May*.
學校運動會在五月。
Our class trip is in *early May* this year.
我們班今年的校外教學在五月初。
